ModernLoop integrates deeply with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Avature), calendar and video tools (Google, Microsoft Outlook/Teams, Zoom, Google Meet), communication (Slack, Gmail), coding assessment (CoderPad, CodeSignal, Codility, HackerRank), and SSO providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID). The platform is delivered as SaaS: it consumes partner APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server. Backed by Accel. This profile was enriched from ModernLoop's public site, trust center, and status page.

providers.name: Talentium
providers.description: Talentium is an end-to-end, AI-powered hiring platform that automates candidate sourcing, screening, and outreach so founders, in-house talent teams, and recruitment agencies can fill roles faster. It combines deep talent search across public sources (including technical talent on GitHub), your own network, and applicant pools with AI ranking, a unified candidate-communication inbox, interview assistance, branded career pages with job-board distribution, and ATS pipeline tracking — plus an autonomous hiring assistant ("Ted") and 60+ integrations. The platform is GDPR-compliant, hosted in EU data centers with end-to-end encryption, and is available on the Google Cloud Marketplace. Backed by EQT Ventures. This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Talentium publishes no public developer/API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Trusted Health
providers.description: Trusted Health is a career marketplace and workforce platform for travel nurses and allied health professionals across the United States. Clinicians build a single Trusted profile and get matched to travel and per-diem assignments, with transparent pay, licensure and compact-state guidance, and support through onboarding, credentialing, and placement. Its Works.AI product gives healthcare employers an AI-assisted staffing and workforce-management tool. Backed by Craft Ventures, Trusted Health operates a consumer web and mobile application (app.trustedhealth.com) rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or SDK surface is published. This profile captures the company's real security, trust, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Wonolo
providers.description: Wonolo is an on-demand staffing marketplace, founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, that connects businesses needing flexible frontline labor with a pool of vetted independent workers ("Wonoloers") for warehousing, manufacturing, food production, retail, hospitality and general labor jobs. Businesses post job requests and are matched to available workers in real time without resumes or interviews, for one-off, ongoing and temp-to-hire needs. Wonolo operates a REST integration API (V2) on api.wonolo.com that lets customers create and manage job requests, jobs, workers and users programmatically and receive webhook callbacks, so scheduling, timekeeping, HR and CRM systems can be wired directly into the staffing platform.

providers.name: Lively
providers.description: Lively is a fintech-healthtech company that provides modern, cloud-based Health Savings Accounts (HSA) alongside Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Reimbursement Arrangements (HRA), COBRA, and commuter benefits for individuals, families, employers, benefits administrators, and third-party administrators. Lively pairs interest-bearing and investment-enabled HSAs (via a Schwab Health Savings Brokerage Account and a guided HSA portfolio) with an employer dashboard for contributions and administration, positioning itself around transparent, zero-hidden-fee pricing. Backed by Costanoa Ventures and GGV Capital, Lively integrates with benefit administration platforms and third-party administrators but does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is handled through its sales and partnerships channels. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Lively's public web surface.

providers.name: Taito.ai
providers.description: Taito.ai is an AI-native people operations (HRIS) platform headquartered in Helsinki, Finland, built for teams scaling from roughly 30 to 300 employees. It unifies the employee lifecycle in one system — a people directory, time-off and attendance, documents and eSignatures, and performance reviews — alongside AI "people agents" that handle onboarding, reminders, payroll reporting, and policy questions on demand from Slack, Claude, or any MCP-compatible tool. Every platform action is exposed over the Model Context Protocol rather than a public REST API. Pricing is a single per-seat tier covering both the people-ops and performance modules. The company is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant, publishing audit reports on a Vanta-hosted Trust Center, and raised a $2.7M seed round led by Accel.

providers.name: TriNet Group
providers.description: TriNet Group is a professional employer organization (PEO) providing small and midsize businesses with full-service human resources solutions including payroll processing, employee benefits administration, risk management, compliance, and HR technology. TriNet serves over 16,000 companies and 340,000 worksite employees across verticals including technology, financial services, life sciences, professional services, and nonprofits.

providers.name: BrightHire
providers.description: BrightHire is an interview intelligence platform that helps talent and hiring teams run more consistent, equitable, and effective hiring processes. Its AI copilots and agents support the full interview lifecycle — interview planning, AI-assisted screening interviews, automated interview notes and highlights, structured decision support, and interviewer coaching — with deep integrations into applicant tracking systems, video conferencing, and collaboration tools. BrightHire is a closed SaaS product with no public developer API; it exposes value through partner ATS, calendar, and conferencing integrations rather than a documented API surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as an index-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Worksmith
providers.description: Worksmith is a retail operations platform founded in 2015 that unites workplace and workforce management for multi-location retailers. Worksmith Workplace covers facilities management, vendor sourcing, maintenance, and work-order tracking through a curated nationwide network of vetted service providers, while Worksmith Workforce (Progress Retail) covers scheduling, task management, training, and store audits. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant, publishes a public status page that lists a Worksmith API component, and runs a private GraphQL API at api.worksmith.com with no public developer program. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Unmind
providers.description: Unmind is a workplace mental health platform that supports employees, develops leaders, and strengthens organisational performance through therapy, coaching, manager training, crisis care, an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), wellbeing content, insights and assessments, and Nova, an AI wellbeing coach. Customers include Uber, MLB, Samsung, British Airways, Diageo, and the NHS. Unmind publishes no public developer API; api.unmind.com is a private Apollo GraphQL backend serving its own apps.

providers.name: Workrise
providers.description: Workrise - which returned to its original RigUp brand in September 2024 - is an Austin-based source-to-pay platform for the energy industry, combining vendor management, contingent workforce staffing, bid management, capital management, and field-service payments for upstream and midstream oil and gas operators. Backed by a16z and Founders Fund. The company publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; platform access is through accounts.rigup.com (OpenID Connect via Auth0), and its engineering org open-sources utilities at github.com/rigup.

providers.name: Zinc
providers.description: Zinc is a UK-founded, Y Combinator and Seedcamp-backed background checking platform that automates pre-employment screening for HR and talent teams. It runs criminal record checks across 195 countries, employment and reference verification, financial and adverse-media screening, right-to-work and qualification checks, delivering results in hours rather than weeks with an average three-day turnaround. Zinc integrates with major ATS and HRIS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, HiBob, SAP SuccessFactors and others) and is ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, GDPR and FCRA aligned. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched from Zinc's public web surface; no public developer API or OpenAPI specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Athena
providers.description: Athena is an executive assistant service that pairs entrepreneurs, founders, and executives with dedicated, full-time remote executive assistants, along with the recruiting, training, and delegation coaching needed to work with them effectively. Athena screens a large global applicant pool and accepts only a small fraction, then equips its assistants with proprietary in-house AI tooling to maximize productivity across email, scheduling, research, travel, and day-to-day operations. The company is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico and is backed by investors including Khosla Ventures. Athena is a services company with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Earnin
providers.description: Earnin (formerly Activehours) is a consumer financial technology company offering earned wage access (EWA) that lets workers tap the pay they have already earned before their scheduled payday. Its mobile app products include Cash Out (access earned wages up to $150/day and $1,000/pay period with no mandatory fees), Live Pay and the EarnIn Card, Early Pay, Balance Shield overdraft protection, credit monitoring, FDIC-insured Savings Jars, and an EarnIn Payroll offering for businesses. Earnin is a consumer app rather than an API platform; it publishes no public developer portal or API, but does operate a vulnerability-disclosure program (security.txt via Inspectiv) and a trust center. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, Felicis, Matrix Partners, Ribbit Capital, and Trinity Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Groundswell
providers.description: Groundswell is a corporate social responsibility (CSR) platform that lets companies run employee giving, volunteering, grants, employee assistance funds, and corporate donor-advised funds from a single integrated system. The platform provides instant donation matching and payroll giving, volunteer event management and volunteer grants, AI-assisted grant application scoring and workflow configuration, confidential employee assistance fund applications with rapid funding, tax-efficient corporate DAFs, enterprise impact reporting and analytics, and web plus mobile employee experiences. Groundswell is backed by Felicis and GV and runs on AWS infrastructure with a published trust center and SOC 2 Type I and Type II attestations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; no public developer portal, API, or specification is currently published by the company.

providers.name: HireRight
providers.description: HireRight is a leading global provider of employment background screening, drug and health screening, and workforce verification services, helping more than 28,000 organizations across 200+ countries and territories run and manage their screening programs. Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, HireRight offers 250+ products and services spanning criminal, financial, identity, education and employment verification, compliance, driving records, and Form I-9 checks, and screened roughly 85 million people in 2025. HireRight does not publish a public developer REST API or developer portal; its integration surface is partner- and contract-based, delivered through 70+ prebuilt connectors with 45+ HCM and ATS partners (including Workday, ADP, Oracle, and UKG) and the Applicant Center candidate experience. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public, machine-readable, and security/compliance surface (llms.txt, trust center, disclosure, domain security) rather than an open API.

providers.name: Litify
providers.description: Litify is a legal operating system built on Salesforce that provides REST APIs for managing matters, intakes, documents, tasks, time tracking, billing, and client communications for law firms and legal departments. Integrators access Litify functionality via the Salesforce REST API and the Litify Docrio API under the terms of the Litify API Integration Agreement.

providers.name: AccessHope
providers.description: AccessHope is a Los Angeles-area health benefits company, founded in 2019 and wholly owned by City of Hope, that delivers remote cancer expertise as an employer-sponsored benefit. Its subspecialist teams review a member's pathology, imaging, molecular testing and treatment plan against the latest evidence from a coalition of National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Centers — City of Hope, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Emory Winship, Fred Hutch, Johns Hopkins Kimmel, Northwestern Medicine Lurie, and UT Southwestern Simmons — and return guidance to the member's own local oncologist rather than moving the patient. AccessHope reports roughly 9 million covered members across 700+ employer and health-plan clients, including 70+ Fortune 500 companies. Delivery is business-to-business: employers, benefits consultants, health plans and navigation partners onboard through an eligibility file feed and an implementation-managed workflow, while members and clinical staff use credentialed web portals. AccessHope publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: DataPeople
providers.description: Datapeople is an AI-powered job description management platform (acquired by PayScale) that helps talent and recruiting teams centralize, standardize, and optimize their job content across the hiring workflow. Its products include a Smart Editor for job-content management, a First Draft writing AI, Insights performance and compliance analytics, Guidance and Compliance AI for review and recommendations, and Datapeople Anywhere, which surfaces its guidance inside existing ATS and HRIS systems. Datapeople integrates with applicant tracking systems including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters, iCIMS, Lever, and Gr8People. The company publishes no public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI; its integration surface is delivered through native ATS/HRIS connectors rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Guardian Life
providers.description: The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America is one of the largest mutual life insurance companies in the United States, providing life insurance, disability income insurance, dental insurance, and other employee benefits. Guardian operates a partner developer portal, Guardian Connect, built on Apigee, exposing a catalog of group and retail insurance APIs covering evidence of insurability, member benefits enrollment, policy and plan configuration, group rating and quoting, dental provider directory and verification of benefits, underwriting data, and life illustration. The Member Benefits APIs implement the LIMRA Data Exchange (LDEx) Standards. Access is partner-gated: a partner agreement is established first, after which Guardian issues a registration code and partner key, and API keys are minted per partner app subject to administrator approval. Authentication is JWT with OpenID Connect login. No OpenAPI, Swagger, or other machine-readable contract is published publicly — the API reference sits behind partner login — so the APIs below are recorded from Guardian's own public catalog descriptions.

providers.name: Hallo
providers.description: Hallo is an AI-powered language assessment and language-learning company backed by Battery Ventures. Its enterprise platform delivers automated, AI-driven proficiency assessments across speaking, writing, listening, and reading in 80+ languages, with CEFR-aligned scoring, detailed feedback (fluency, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, coherence), real-time score reports and dashboards, and proctoring / anti-cheating for high-stakes hiring, placement testing, and employee development. Hallo integrates with major applicant-tracking systems (Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Lever, SuccessFactors, Recruitee, and others) and runs assessments across 160+ countries, with a stated SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and EU AI Act compliance posture. The company also operates a consumer language-learning app with AI tutors and native-speaker practice. Hallo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; its integration surface is delivered through prebuilt ATS connectors and enterprise onboarding rather than a self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Metaview
providers.description: Metaview is an AI-native, agentic recruiting platform used by more than 5,000 organizations to source, engage, and hire candidates. Its autonomous agents handle candidate sourcing, inbound application review against an Ideal Candidate Profile, AI interview notetaking purpose-built for recruiting, personalized outreach sequences, customizable recruiting reports, and job-post generation. Metaview integrates two-way with 60+ recruiting tools including ATS platforms (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Gem, SmartRecruiters, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors), video conferencing (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams), scheduling, and SSO providers. The company is backed by GV and Seedcamp. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile captures its identity, llms.txt, trust posture (SOC 2, GDPR), and domain security for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Simpatico Project
providers.description: Simpatico Project (유쾌한프로젝트, Yukwaehan Project Co., Ltd.) is a Korean B2B mental-wellness startup, backed by 500 Global, whose product Clify (클라이피, "Climb & Clarify") is an AI-based integrated mental-care and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) solution for individuals and companies. Clify uses a patented multimodal algorithm to fuse Face & Voice biosignals — blood-flow changes, micro-expressions and voice characteristics — into a roughly one-minute mental-state diagnosis (stress, anxiety, depression, burnout) that it claims exceeds 90% accuracy, and rolls the results up into an organization insight dashboard for HR (company-wide mental trends, high/low-risk teams, usage). Personal mental data is processed on-device and de-identified so it is never shared with the employer, and the company states it holds ISO 27001. Product surfaces include FAV (the Face & Voice AI diagnosis engine), an EAP counseling center, and the Clify organization-insight analytics. The public presence (clify.co.kr, an imweb-built marketing and account site) exposes no developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Carrot
providers.description: Carrot is a global fertility and family-building benefits platform that helps employers, health plans, benefits consultants, and labor unions offer inclusive reproductive care to their members. Carrot supports the full journey — preconception, IVF and IUI, egg, sperm, and embryo preservation, gestational surrogacy, adoption, pregnancy and postpartum care, men's health, and hormonal and menopause support — across 175+ countries and 17,000+ providers. Products include Carrot Intelligence (an AI clinical platform), Carrot Rx medication sourcing, the Carrot Card payment solution, and Carrot Sprints metabolic-fertility programs. Backed by CRV; added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio enrichment.

providers.name: Pasito
providers.description: Pasito is an AI-native workspace for employee benefits that helps benefits consultants, insurance carriers, and employers simplify every part of the benefits journey — from proposal and quoting through enrollment to year-round employee engagement — using agentic AI workflows. The platform turns unstructured plan documents and census data into a structured data layer that powers a conversational AI benefits assistant, automated proposal/RFP intake, benefits guides and microsites, decision support, and communications. Pasito reports supporting over 6.6 million employees, managing $106B in premiums, and serving 3,600+ employers, integrating with 950+ TPA systems and 260+ HRIS platforms. Backed by Google, Y Combinator, and Core Innovation Capital, the company is building a public-facing API but does not yet publish a developer portal, documentation, or API reference.

providers.name: Pie Insurance
providers.description: Pie Insurance is a small business workers compensation insurance platform that provides a REST API for approved partners to quote, bind, and manage workers comp policies. The partner API supports appetite checking, price indication, quote submission, document upload, and retrieval of bindable quotes, enabling agencies, aggregators, and technology platforms to embed workers comp quoting directly into their own workflows. Pie targets small businesses across 39 states and Washington D.C., using data-driven underwriting to offer savings of up to 30% versus traditional carriers. Payroll-based premium calculations and policy management including certificates of insurance are central to the platform.

providers.name: Successfactors
providers.description: SuccessFactors is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) company founded in 2001 and an early Canaan Partners portfolio company that IPO'd in 2007 and was acquired by SAP in 2012. It is now delivered as the SAP SuccessFactors HXM (Human Experience Management) Suite, covering core HR (Employee Central), Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning (LMS), Succession & Development, and Workforce Analytics. SuccessFactors exposes an extensive integration surface through OData v2 and OData v4 APIs (the SFAPI/OData platform) documented on the SAP Business Accelerator Hub, using OAuth 2.0 SAML bearer-assertion and basic authentication per customer datacenter instance.

providers.name: Cocoon
providers.description: Cocoon is next-generation employee leave management software that automates the complexities of compliance, claims, and payroll for every type of employee leave (parental, medical, caregiver, accommodation, bereavement, and personal) across all 50 U.S. states. It factors in state, federal, company, and insurance benefits to calculate eligibility, generate designation notices, and streamline the leave experience for both employees and HR teams. Cocoon connects to 20+ HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, ADP, Paylocity, UKG, and more) via API integrations that sync employee data in real time. Founded in 2020 by former Stripe and Square leaders and backed by Index Ventures and First Round Capital, Cocoon was acquired by TriNet in April 2026. Cocoon is a consumer of HRIS/payroll APIs rather than a publisher of a public developer API; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal are published.

providers.name: HireVue
providers.description: HireVue is an AI-driven hiring platform built around video interviewing, conversational AI, structured assessments, automated scheduling, and an AI Hiring Agent. The platform plugs into the major ATS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle/Taleo, iCIMS, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters, PageUp, Cornerstone, Avature, Oleeo, BrassRing) and exposes REST APIs and webhooks to customers and certified partners via the HireVue developer portal at developer.hirevue.com. At the time of this profile the public developer portal was not responding to crawl, so APIs are listed at the product/capability level and the developer portal URL is captured as the canonical reference.

providers.name: MentorCloud
providers.description: MentorCloud is an AI-enabled, enterprise mentoring software platform that helps organizations optimize employee engagement, retention, and career development through structured mentoring programs. It serves HR and Learning & Development teams and enterprise leaders looking to scale human-led learning across engineering, management, higher education, hospitality, and non-profit contexts. The platform covers mentor/mentee matching, program management, sessions, circles, learning, and community, with use cases spanning new-hire onboarding, leadership development, career progression, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) initiatives. MentorCloud is delivered as a hosted B2B SaaS product with managed, custom two-way integrations to enterprise CRM, HR, and single sign-on systems rather than a self-serve public developer API. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Palm HR
providers.description: Palm HR (palm.hr, operating on palmhr.net) is an HR management and payroll platform built specifically for the UAE and broader MENA region, trusted by organizations from startups to enterprises for local labor-law and WPS compliance. The platform spans people management (employee profiles, onboarding and offboarding, document management), attendance and time tracking (mobile check-in/out, timesheets, shift scheduling, project time), payroll automation (WPS-compliant processing, expenses, loans, multi-country and multi-currency), performance management, and recruiting, plus an outsourced-HR service. Palm HR exposes REST APIs with API keys carrying granular permissions so customers can push data to ERPs and external tools, and ships prebuilt integrations with accounting suites (Xero, QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Wafeq, Qoyod, Odoo, Tally), biometric devices (ZKTeco, CAMS), and automation platforms (Zapier, Make, Power Automate). The company is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. This profile was enriched from public web surfaces; no public OpenAPI specification or developer portal was discovered.

providers.name: Paradox
providers.description: Paradox builds Olivia, a conversational AI assistant for high-volume hiring. The platform is delivered as a suite of "Conversational" products - ATS, CRM, Career Sites, Apply, Scheduling, and Events - and ships pre-built integrations for Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, and Indeed plus an Open API for custom partner integrations with systems like iCIMS, Greenhouse, and others. Paradox is sales-led; APIs are made available to enterprise customers and certified partners under contract rather than via a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: ConstructionOnline
providers.description: ConstructionOnline is UDA Technologies' cloud construction project management platform covering estimating, scheduling, budgets, change orders, daily logs, file sharing, and client and subcontractor collaboration. UDA exposes the platform through a documented REST API available to ConstructionOnline Business and Enterprise customers, with read and write access for projects, contacts, schedules, and financials. Access is gated by an application process (api@uda1.com), authenticated with company-issued credentials, and rate-limited to 500 requests per hour per account.

providers.name: Hackajob
providers.description: Hackajob is a UK-founded (2015) tech-recruitment platform that connects jobseekers and employers across the UK and US using AI hiring agents. Its flagship product, Archer, is an always-on AI sourcing agent that finds, qualifies, and introduces high-fit passive candidates directly into an employer's ATS, complemented by agents Chase (AI recruiter) and Thena (applicant screening). Alongside the AI agents it runs an On-Demand contract hiring marketplace, a Talent Intelligence / hiring-insights product, an Upskill skills-assessment tool, and public jobs and company directories drawing on a talent network of 1.5M+ vetted knowledge workers. Hackajob does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK; this profile captures its public web, security, and trust surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched from real public sources.

providers.name: Empathy
providers.description: Empathy is a support platform that helps organizations guide people through loss, leave, and legacy moments, combining AI with human care to serve individuals navigating grief, estate planning, and major life transitions. Its products include LifeVault digital estate planning, Loss Support for beneficiaries handling claims and grief, Leave Support for employees during difficult life events, and Client Connect for advisors. Empathy sells to life insurance companies, banks and wealth managers, employers, health plans, and benefit consultants, covering 50M+ individuals. Backed by General Catalyst and Index Ventures. As of this profile Empathy publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Family First
providers.description: Family First is an employee caregiving benefits provider that pairs certified Care Experts with a Care Hub mobile app to support working caregivers. The platform helps employers, health plans, and small businesses deliver caregiving advocacy, backup and subsidized care, and expert guidance across aging-parent care, mental health, chronic illness, caregiver burnout, fertility, childcare, veterans support, end-of-life planning, and financial and legal planning. The company operates under SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST i1, HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR frameworks and is Techstars-backed. Family First does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security posture.

providers.name: Nomi Health
providers.description: Nomi Health is a Utah-based direct healthcare and healthcare fintech company founded in 2019 that operates a payments, claims and analytics platform for self-funded employers, health plans, brokers and providers. Its stack spans real-time provider payments and claims adjudication (Healthcare Financial Services), directly contracted provider networks (Direct Network / Open Network), benefits-data analytics through Artemis by Nomi Health, and direct patient care services. Nomi Health operates authenticated web portals for providers, members and employers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Shiftsmart
providers.description: Shiftsmart is a workforce management and flexible-labor platform that connects enterprises and government agencies with a community of independent workers across more than 50 countries. The platform covers the full labor lifecycle — sourcing workers from profiles carrying credentials and performance metrics, onboarding and training them into custom labor pools, building optimized schedules from rules and templates, dispatching shifts by in-app notification or SMS, tracking GPS-verified attendance and productivity, and paying workers within 24 hours via real-time debit transfers and payroll integrations. Shiftsmart also runs location-level audits, mystery shopping and compliance programs on top of the same labor network. The platform is delivered through worker and manager mobile applications backed by a private REST API at api.shiftsmart.com; Shiftsmart publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aware Health
providers.description: Aware Health is an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) care platform that helps employers, health plans, and brokers reduce MSK spend while preventing orthopedic surgeries and chronic pain. The company pairs licensed clinicians (physical therapists and health coaches) with an AI "Predict" engine to triage, navigate, and manage musculoskeletal conditions virtually, and reports reducing MSK costs by roughly 30%. Its platform spans MSK care, chronic care, surgery decision support, member navigation, analytics, and an employer dashboard, delivered via web and an iOS app. Aware Health is a Techstars portfolio company and has raised seed funding (including a $3M round led by Boomerang VC with Bright Ventures). This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Aware Health does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: TriNet Zenefits
providers.description: TriNet Zenefits (formerly Zenefits) is an all-in-one cloud HR platform for small and medium-sized businesses, providing payroll, benefits administration, time and scheduling, hiring and onboarding, performance management, and compliance in a single system of record. Acquired by TriNet in 2022, the platform combines self-service HR software with optional advisory services. TriNet Zenefits exposes a REST API at https://api.zenefits.com for programmatic access to people, companies, employments, compensation, payroll, and time-off resources, secured via OAuth 2.0.

providers.name: Beamery
providers.description: Beamery is an AI-powered talent lifecycle management and workforce transformation platform used by enterprises to unify fragmented talent data and run skills-based hiring. It combines a talent CRM (candidate relationship management), talent marketing, workforce and skills intelligence, internal talent mobility, and AI-driven candidate recommendations into a single system of record for talent. Beamery integrates with HR ecosystems such as Workday and SAP SuccessFactors and is delivered as enterprise SaaS. Backed by EQT Ventures and Index Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched with its public security, compliance, and trust surface. Sector: hr-tech.

providers.name: Lantern
providers.description: Lantern (legal entity Employer Direct Healthcare, LLC dba Lantern Specialty Care) is a US specialty care platform that connects members with high-quality, lower-cost care for surgery, cancer and infusion therapy — the complex, high-cost episodes that account for roughly half of healthcare spending. Founded in 2011 as SurgeryPlus and later expanded into cancer and infusion care, Lantern sells to employers, public-sector employers, labor union trusts, health plans and benefits consultants, pairing a hand-selected "Network of Excellence" of specialists with dedicated care teams that navigate a member end to end through a treatment journey. Lantern is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Lantern publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or discovery surface — this profile captures its public company, trust and security posture only.

providers.name: Voiio
providers.description: Voiio is a German employee assistance and work-life balance platform, positioning itself as "#1 in Work-Life-Balance" in the German market. The platform provides employee support across all life stages (family planning, childcare, eldercare, personal wellness, career support) through digital services, coaching, live lectures, expert referrals, and a 24/7 accessible portal. Integration with employer systems is available via Magic Links (authenticated deep-link URLs) and a white-label customization approach. No public REST API or developer portal has been identified; integrations are enterprise-contract based.

providers.name: Zenjob
providers.description: Zenjob is a Berlin-based staffing platform that connects businesses with vetted temporary workers (students and side-jobbers) through a mobile app and a self-service booking platform (Buchungsplattform). Companies create shifts, staff them in real time, track working hours, and handle invoicing in one place. Zenjob offers an integration layer (marketed as "Schnittstellen (API)") for personnel management, shift creation and staffing, time tracking, and billing, plus partner integrations with workforce and vendor-management systems including Quinyx, ATOSS, Ubeya, and compleet. The API is partner/consultation-led (arranged via a scheduled onboarding call) rather than a self-serve public developer program; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDK. Backed by 500 Global, Zenjob was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Entelo
providers.description: Entelo is an AI-powered talent-sourcing and recruiting-automation platform for finding, engaging, and hiring candidates using predictive analytics, diversity-aware search, and candidate-engagement tooling. Entelo was acquired and is now delivered as "Entelo Recruit" within Rival (rival-hr.com), an AI-powered HR orchestration suite spanning recruiting, workflow, learning, and performance. Its former domain entelo.com now 301-redirects to Rival. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published for the Entelo/Rival Recruit product.

providers.name: Glassdoor
providers.description: Glassdoor is an online platform for company reviews, salary reports, and job listings, now part of Recruit Holdings (alongside Indeed) and tightly integrated with the broader Workday talent ecosystem. Historically Glassdoor offered a public Partner Job Search / Employer Reviews API (api.glassdoor.com/api/api.htm), but the program was closed to new applications in 2021 and active integrations require an existing partner relationship. Current API access is enterprise sales-led for ATS, programmatic recruitment, and employer-brand partners. No self-serve developer portal is active today.

providers.name: Wolf
providers.description: Wolf (fromwolf.com) is a white-label, multi-tenant staffing and gig-work platform that lets staffing companies run their own branded on-demand workforce. Its API coordinates job seekers, clients, campaigns (client orders), shifts, tenders (a seeker's request to work a shift), applications, timesheets, availability, notifications, and in-app chat — everything needed to build a client- or worker-facing staffing interface on top of the Wolf backend. Each tenant runs on its own database and authenticates with a tenant key plus a platform API key or per-user authentication token. Wolf was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: WorkForce Software
providers.description: WorkForce Software, an ADP company since October 2024, makes the WorkForce Suite, an enterprise workforce management platform covering time and attendance, employee scheduling, absence and leave management, labor forecasting, data capture, and payroll compliance for large, complex organizations. The Suite integrates with leading HCM and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, ADP) via RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, and file-based interfaces, with SSO/SLO and MFA support; API and integration documentation is provided to customers through the WorkForce Software community portal rather than a public developer portal.

providers.name: BetterUp
providers.description: BetterUp is an enterprise Human Transformation Platform that combines human and AI-powered coaching, grounded in behavioral science and enterprise data, to help organizations develop leaders, managers, and their broader workforce. Founded by Alexi Robichaux, BetterUp serves 750+ enterprise customers including Google, Salesforce, Moderna, and Workday, with a network of 4,000+ coaches across 70+ countries. The platform delivers leadership development, manager effectiveness, AI coaching, and workforce resilience programs. BetterUp is HR-tech / organizational-development software and exposes no public developer API; platform integration is delivered through packaged enterprise connectors (Workday, Salesforce, Slack, Microsoft Viva, SAP SuccessFactors, Degreed) plus HRIS and SSO provisioning. Sector: hr-tech.

providers.name: ConnectRN
providers.description: connectRN is a Waltham, Massachusetts based per-diem (PRN) healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nurses, CNAs and allied clinicians with open shifts at hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and skilled nursing facilities across the United States. Clinicians browse and claim shifts through the connectRN mobile app with no minimum commitment, no required weekends or holidays, and same-day pay; facilities post shifts, auto-backfill open coverage and approve timesheets through a web platform at app.connectrn.com. In April 2026 connectRN merged with SnapCare, combining connectRN's PRN clinician community with SnapCare's Booker workforce technology platform. connectRN operates a public status page but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its API host api.connectrn.com serves the first-party mobile and web applications only.

providers.name: Heard
providers.description: Heard (Heard Technologies, Inc.) is the financial management platform built specifically for therapists and wellness practitioners in private practice. Founded in 2019 and based in Seattle, Washington, Heard pairs easy-to-use software with a dedicated human team to handle bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and business banking in a single subscription, so licensed mental health and allied health clinicians can focus on their clients. Heard serves solo and single-owner group practices across the United States, from newer sole proprietors to established S corporations, and connects with tools practices already use such as SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Headway, Jane App, Stripe, and Square. Heard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity, its public web properties, and the published llms.txt.

providers.name: Openroll
providers.description: Openroll is an AI-native operating system for compensation, built for People and Finance teams. It connects to existing HRIS, ATS, ERP, and finance systems, runs fully auditable analyses, and turns repeated workflows into agentic operations - covering compensation reviews, salary bands, headcount planning, pay-strategy monitoring, and actuals-versus-budget variance. Founded in 2024 and backed by Y Combinator, Openroll operates from San Francisco and Stockholm, is SOC 2 Type I and Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and never uses customer data to train its AI models.

providers.name: Traba
providers.description: Traba is a New York City-based staffing marketplace and AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain, founded in 2021 and backed by Founders Fund. Traba connects vetted, high-reliability light-industrial workers with production plants, warehouses, and distribution centers, and pairs that staffing marketplace with Neo, an AI intelligence layer that unifies live operational data across WMS, ERP, HRIS, TMS, and payroll systems, surfaces root causes, and automates approved supply chain workflows. Traba publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: ShiftMed
providers.description: ShiftMed is a McLean, Virginia healthcare workforce technology company operating an on-demand clinician marketplace and AI-powered open shift management platform for hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities and post-acute providers. It matches credentialed W-2 CNAs, LPNs and RNs to open shifts, and markets an API that lets a facility tap that clinician network directly from its own scheduling stack. The API surface reaches customers through workforce-management partner integrations — UKG Pro Workforce Management (formerly UKG Dimensions), symplr Smart Square, QGenda, Smartlinx and Attendance on Demand — alongside file-based SFTP feeds. ShiftMed publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification or SDK; API access is arranged through a workforce consultation.

providers.name: Bippit
providers.description: Bippit is a UK-based financial wellbeing platform that gives every employee access to personal, qualified financial coaching alongside AI-powered guidance available 24/7, planning and budgeting tools, payroll savings, and educational content and webinars. Sold to employers as a workplace benefit, it also provides organisations with aggregate financial-wellbeing insights and analytics. Bippit is FCA-regulated (No. 845814), ICO-registered (No. ZA533579), ISO 27001:2022 certified, and GDPR / UK DPA 2018 compliant, with data stored in the EEA. Backed by Techstars. Bippit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and compliance surface.

providers.name: Collective
providers.description: Collective is an all-in-one financial back-office platform built for self-employed entrepreneurs, solopreneurs, and businesses-of-one. It bundles S Corp formation and election, bookkeeping, payroll (as a Gusto partner), business and personal tax preparation and filing, quarterly tax planning, and a dedicated accounting team into a single membership. Roughly 12,000 members use Collective to optimize self-employment taxes, with members reporting average annual business-tax savings around $10,000. Collective is a private fintech company backed by General Catalyst, Kindred Ventures, and QED Investors. It currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web, security, and compliance footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Incredible Health
providers.description: Incredible Health is an AI-native healthcare career marketplace that connects registered nurses, technicians, and technologists with permanent jobs at top hospitals and health systems. It flips traditional recruiting by having employers apply to pre-screened, verified professionals rather than the reverse. The platform serves 1.5 million+ U.S. healthcare workers and 1,500+ employers, including a majority of the nation's top-ranked hospital systems, cutting time-to-hire from a national average of roughly 86 days to under 20. Two purpose-built AI agents power the marketplace: Gale, a career partner for professionals (resume wizard, interview practice), and Lyn, a voice interview agent for employers that integrates with applicant-tracking systems. Founded by Iman Abuzeid, MD, and headquartered in San Francisco, the company is venture-backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Obvious Ventures, and NFX.

providers.name: Jify
providers.description: Jify is an India-based financial wellness platform (part of the Moneyview group) that partners with employers to give employees earned wage access: its On-Demand Salary lets workers draw already-earned pay before payday. Beyond earned wage access it offers salary advances, a rewards and discount marketplace, micro-savings, digital gold investing, credit-score tracking, smart tax tools, and a money manager for budgeting and expense tracking, delivered through Android and iOS apps. Jify is a consumer / B2B2C fintech app and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, domain-security posture, and published compliance claims (ISO 27001, CISA-certified, independently tested by Appknox).

providers.name: Newfront
providers.description: Newfront is a modern business insurance brokerage and technology company headquartered in San Francisco. It combines a traditional insurance brokerage (commercial business insurance, employee benefits, retirement services, and risk management) with a software platform that gives clients transparent data and analytics to understand and lower their total cost of risk. Formed from the merger of Newfront and ABD Insurance, the company serves technology, venture-backed, and enterprise clients across property and casualty, health and benefits, and personal lines. Backed by Index Ventures, Susa Ventures, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Newfront exposes a client-facing web application (app.newfront.com) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Pointone
providers.description: PointOne is an AI-powered legal practice management platform that automates time entry, billing compliance, and analytics for law firms. Its products include PointOne Time (automatic cross-device time capture with AI-generated narratives), PointOne Review (pre-bill review with AI markup and collaboration), and PointOne Intelligence (time analytics and resource-allocation insights), along with automatic enforcement of Outside Counsel Guidelines. The platform syncs with billing systems including Aderant, Clio, Filevine, QuickBooks, Actionstep, Elite 3E, Surepoint, MyCase, and LeanLaw, and serves 200+ law firms. PointOne is backed by Bessemer, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and 8VC. No public developer API is currently published; integrations are delivered as pre-built connectors.

providers.name: Workhint
providers.description: Workhint is a work orchestration platform that uses AI to configure workflows, roles, and operations from modular components, helping teams manage flexible and on-demand workforces. The platform spans sourcing and onboarding, a workflow engine, tasks and projects, shifts and field visits, delivery management, auto-invoicing, global payments and payout workflows, contract management, and 1099 compliance. Backed by 500 Global and Softeq. API access and custom integrations are offered on the Enterprise plan, but no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Wuzzuf
providers.description: Wuzzuf is Egypt's leading online recruitment platform, operated by Cairo-based BasharSoft and backed by investors including 500 Global. It connects millions of job seekers with tens of thousands of employers across Egypt and the Middle East, offering job search, applicant tracking, employer branding pages, and recruitment products for companies. Wuzzuf does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Ebix
providers.description: Ebix is a United States insurance software and exchange company headquartered in Johns Creek, Georgia, operating as market infrastructure between carriers, MGAs, brokers and agencies rather than as a carrier itself. Its portfolio spans property and casualty agency management (EbixASP), P&C policy administration and broker systems (EbixEvolution, PlacingHub, Sunrise Exchange, iClose), life insurance and annuity distribution connectivity (EbixExchange), health insurance and employee benefits administration, health content, risk and compliance (RiskEnvision, WCExchange), and — through the EbixCash arm — travel, payments and forex services. Its core P&C plumbing is ACORD-native rather than API-native: TEAM-UP moves policy, claims and direct-bill commission download to agency management systems as ACORD-standard AL3 files, its Translation Services practice converts carrier-proprietary formats into ACORD AL3 and ACORD XML using Java/XML/XSLT, EbixASP maintains a continuously updated ACORD forms library with bi-directional exchange against ACORD applications, and the EbixASP Real-Time Interface synchronizes carrier credentials and service transactions with IVANS. Ebix markets API-driven quote-to-bind workflows and, since October 2025, a plug-and-play connector platform built with 1SilverBullet that exposes quoting, eApp, enrollment, underwriting checks, payments and policy servicing as modular APIs with "a standardized connector fabric with pre-built mappings and a developer portal" — but no public self-serve developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification could be confirmed as of 2026-07-25. Every probed developer path on ebix.com (/developers, /api, /developer, /partners, /integrations) returns the site's single-page-app homepage shell rather than a developer surface; developer.ebix.com and docs.ebix.com do not resolve; api.ebix.com answers with a JSON 404 and no documented routes; and the live EbixCash API Hub at api.ebixcash.com serves an OpenAPI document that returns HTTP 401 "Missing Authorization header". The one agent-facing discovery document Ebix does publish is a real llms.txt at www.ebix.com/llms.txt, which indexes the solution, service and corporate pages but names no API, portal or specification; every /.well-known/ probe across www.ebix.com, api.ebix.com, api.ebixcash.com and ebixasp.com missed, no first-party SDK exists in any public package registry, and no trust center, security.txt or vulnerability-disclosure program was found. Ebix's integration surface is therefore customer- and partner-gated, sold and documented under contract, which is the norm for United States insurance infrastructure where no federal regulator and no open-insurance mandate exists. Ebix filed Chapter 11 in December 2023, sold its North American life and annuity assets to Zinnia, and exited bankruptcy on 30 August 2024 consolidated with Eraaya Lifespaces.

providers.name: Inkling
providers.description: Inkling is a frontline employee training and enablement platform (now part of Echo360) that delivers mission-critical knowledge, learning pathways, and operational workflows to essential workers across retail, hospitality, healthcare, and manufacturing. Its products include the Habitat content authoring tool, mobile Knowledge & Training modules, InkForms operational checklists, certification pathways, reporting and analytics, and LMS/LXP integrations. Inkling publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through LMS/LXP connectors and professional services. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched with the provider's public identity, security posture, and site properties.

providers.name: Brightfield
providers.description: Brightfield is an extended-workforce intelligence company whose TDX (Talent Data Exchange) and TDX AI platform give enterprises data, automation, and precision over contingent-labor and statement-of-work (SOW) spending across 100+ countries. Products include Rate Intelligence, Rate Card Manager, SOW Rate Insights, SOW Quality and Risk Analytics, Supplier Scorecard, and an ROI Dashboard, built on transaction-level data from 700+ companies and $500B+ of global spend. Founded and led by CEO Jason Ezratty and headquartered in Washington, DC, Brightfield is backed by Sapphire Ventures. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application; no public developer API or documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Coursebase
providers.description: Coursebase is an AI-powered corporate Learning Management System (LMS) used by over 1,000 organizations to create, deliver, and manage employee training across online, in-person, and blended formats. The platform offers a library of 1,000+ pre-built eLearning courses, AI-assisted content generation (auto-generated test questions and course summaries), analytics and reporting dashboards, single sign-on, multi-language support, and API-based integration with external HR systems for syncing user account information. Coursebase was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched in the API Evangelist network; the public surface is a marketing site with an enterprise "contact us" API integration offering rather than a self-serve developer portal or published OpenAPI.

providers.name: Donut
providers.description: Donut is an employee experience platform that helps companies design, automate, and scale people programs directly inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Best known for its intro and coffee-chat pairing bot, Donut runs onboarding journeys, team-connection and watercooler programs, peer recognition, and engagement surveys, and imports data from 50+ HRIS systems (BambooHR, Greenhouse, Workday) alongside Zoom, Google Meet, and calendar integrations. It is trusted by 20,000+ teams including Anthropic, Figma, Carta, and Ramp. Donut authenticates users via Slack OAuth and is SOC 2 compliant. It does not currently publish a public developer API; its GitHub organization ships a Slack app template and internal tooling.

providers.name: HireArt
providers.description: HireArt is a workforce management platform that helps enterprises source, employ, and manage their contingent workforce - contract workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors - through a single self-serve system. Its products span Employer of Record (EOR), on-demand sourcing and recruitment, a Vendor Management System (VMS), worker classification and compliance (1099 vs. W-2 with indemnification), program management, and freelancer management. Customers include Toyota Research Institute, Zoox, Via, Scale AI, Dropbox, Meta Quest, Carta, and Rover. HireArt was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Lockton
providers.description: Lockton Companies is the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, founded by Jack Lockton in 1966 and headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, United States. Lockton is a broker and intermediary rather than a risk carrier: it places commercial property and casualty, specialty and financial lines, employee benefits and people solutions, private client coverage, and — through Lockton Re — treaty and facultative reinsurance, for tens of thousands of clients across a global network of associates and offices reaching more than 140 locations. Its API posture is honestly characterized as partner-gated with no public API surface. As of July 2026 Lockton publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, no GraphQL endpoint, no Postman workspace, and no webhook or event catalog. The hostnames developer.lockton.com, developers.lockton.com, docs.lockton.com and api.lockton.com do not resolve in DNS, and a crawl of the 6,953 URLs in global.lockton.com/sitemap.xml surfaces no developer, API, ACORD, IVANS, OpenAPI or Swagger path. Client-facing technology is delivered through authenticated regional Lockton Client Portals and the proprietary Lockton SAGE intelligence and analytics ecosystem, which is presented on the website behind a contact form with no self-serve access, no documented data feed and no published integration surface. This is the expected posture for a US broker-intermediary: the United States has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate, so data exchange between carriers, brokers and agency management systems runs on ACORD standards in an EDI and forms idiom rather than a public API idiom. Lockton's most substantive standards signal is governance rather than implementation — in July 2026 Nidhi Howell, Chief Business Technology Officer of Lockton Re, was appointed to the ACORD Solutions Group Board of Directors representing the reinsurance broking channel — but no ACORD AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS or IVANS agency-download implementation is documented on any public Lockton property.

providers.name: PickTrace
providers.description: PickTrace is an agricultural workforce and harvest management SaaS platform for large-scale farms, founded by brothers Austin and Harrison Steed and a Y Combinator (Summer 2015) alumnus headquartered in Glendale, California. The platform captures time-and-attendance, piecework, productivity, onboarding, payroll, and receiving data in the field, office, and packinghouse, giving growers real-time visibility across their entire workforce year-round. It is used daily by tens of thousands of farm workers at some of the largest berry, citrus, and apple growers in the United States, Mexico, Peru, Chile, and Australia. PickTrace exposes a RESTful API that lets customers and third-party developers create, update, and extract objects from all PickTrace tools and bi-directionally sync labor data into and out of the platform for automation, payroll efficiency, and audit-ready compliance.

providers.name: Poplin
providers.description: Poplin (formerly SudShare) is a nationwide on-demand laundry pickup and delivery marketplace connecting customers with independent, work-from-home "Laundry Pros" who wash, dry, and fold laundry, serving 500+ cities and 150,000+ customers. Poplin operates two consumer-facing mobile apps - the customer app and the Laundry Pro app - plus a Laundry Pro web portal (laundry-pro.poplin.co), but it does not expose a public or partner developer API. No developer portal or API reference was found at poplin.co, and the api.poplin.co subdomain resolves but returns a bare 404 with no documentation, indicating internal-only use. Business/SMB accounts (property managers, hospitality) are onboarded through sales and an account manager rather than through self-service API keys.

providers.name: Yulife
providers.description: YuLife is a London-founded (2016) technology-driven insurtech and employee benefits platform offering group life insurance, group health insurance, income protection and a gamified wellbeing app. Employees complete everyday wellness activities to earn YuCoin rewards, with access to an EAP, telemedicine and wellbeing apps such as Meditopia. A certified B Corp, YuLife insures 400k+ lives across the UK and US and sells to employers and brokers. It publishes no public developer API or portal; api.yulife.com is the internal app backend (issuer api.uk.yulife.com), and a Vanta Trust Center is at trust.yulife.com.

providers.name: Ben
providers.description: Ben (thanksben.com) is an AI-native global employee benefits and rewards platform for enterprises. It unifies benefits eligibility rules, policy configuration, employee enrollment and access, spend and compliance dashboards, and rewards/recognition into a single system spanning 140+ countries, replacing fragmented regional benefits tooling. Customers include Moet, Henkel, Virgin, Zalando, Deliveroo, and Octopus Energy. Ben is backed by Seedcamp and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API today, so this profile captures the company's identity and its public security and trust surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a Vanta-hosted Trust Center, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Employee Cycle
providers.description: Employee Cycle is an HR analytics and reporting platform that bills itself as "the first Employee Data Platform." It connects a company's HRIS, ATS, payroll, performance, and engagement systems into one place and turns that data into automated, real-time dashboards and reports covering headcount, turnover, tenure, DEI, and other people metrics. The no-code dashboard and report builder lets non-technical HR teams run multi-dimensional workforce analysis without manual spreadsheets, with a claimed one-day implementation. Employee Cycle integrates with 20+ HR systems (ADP, BambooHR, Greenhouse, Lattice, Rippling, UKG, and more) and is aimed at enterprise HR teams, typically at organizations with 500+ employees. The company is SOC 2 compliant (audited by Sensiba San Filippo, monitored by Drata), GDPR and CCPA aligned, and built on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. It is backed by the Techstars accelerator and venture funding. Employee Cycle offers pre-built data integrations rather than a public developer REST API; this profile tracks the company's identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Uno Health
providers.description: Uno Health is a New York-based healthcare technology company that helps Medicare members enroll in the government assistance programs they are eligible for — such as SNAP and utility assistance — saving members an average of $4,500 per year. Medicare Advantage health plans partner with Uno's technology-driven member engagement platform to simplify eligibility checks, subsidy enrollment, plan optimization, and benefits matching, increasing Part C revenue, member retention, and star ratings. Members run a 5-minute savings check, upload enrollment documents, and track recurring monthly savings through the Uno Health Member Portal. Backed by Cowboy Ventures and General Catalyst. Uno Health publishes no public developer program; its API (api.unohealth.com, AWS API Gateway) is private and partner-facing.

providers.name: Zone & Company
providers.description: Zone & Co (Zone & Company) is a NetSuite-native financial operations software vendor whose SuiteApp suite automates the back office across five product families - Quote to Cash (ZoneBilling billing and revenue recognition, ZonePayments Stripe integration), Procure to Pay (ZoneProcure, ZoneCapture, ZoneApprovals), Treasury (ZoneLiquidity cash forecasting, ZoneReconcile), Payroll Management (ZonePayroll, Employee Portal), and Record to Report (ZoneReporting on Power BI, Data Warehouse, ZoneExtract, Solution 7). The products are delivered as native Oracle NetSuite SuiteApps distributed through the SuiteApp Marketplace rather than as a standalone public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Every
providers.description: Every is an AI-native, all-in-one back-office and finance platform built for startups, unifying incorporation, business banking and cards, treasury and cash management, global payroll, HR and benefits, AI-assisted bookkeeping, and startup tax preparation (including R&D tax credits) into a single system. It offers free Delaware C-corp formation, business checking with cashback debit cards, treasury-bill and money-market investing, and bundled per-stage plans for new founders through established startups. Backed by Redpoint Ventures. Every does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, commercial, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Figures
providers.description: Figures is a European compensation management and pay transparency platform that helps HR teams and managers make strategic salary decisions using real-time market data. It combines salary benchmarking across 3.5M+ datapoints, dynamic salary bands, collaborative compensation review workflows, and pay equity analysis, with modules built for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Figures connects to 30+ HRIS and performance-review systems to enrich internal pay data, and is used by organizations including KPMG, EY, Qonto, and TotalEnergies. It is backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; Figures does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Minu
providers.description: Minu is Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform, serving more than 2,000 companies and over 1 million workers. Its flagship product is Salary On-Demand (earned wage access), which lets employees withdraw wages they have already earned before payday, alongside a high-yield savings account, low-interest payroll loans, food and gas vouchers (vales de despensa y gasolina), a rewards card, a corporate expense card, telemedicine, insurance and assistance coverage, a discount club, and a financial-education program. Employers adopt Minu to reduce talent turnover and improve workforce financial wellness. Minu is a QED Investors portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Minu publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Upwage
providers.description: Upwage is an AI interview platform that helps employers hire faster and more fairly with lower turnover. Its emotionally intelligent AI interviewer conducts 24/7 multilingual candidate screening, scoring competencies consistently to reduce bias in high-volume hiring across retail, healthcare, logistics, and staffing, with ATS integrations including Ashby, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Lever, SmartRecruiters, and Workday. Founded by Diana Tsai and Greg Call and backed by Bloomberg Beta, Upwage publishes a SOC 2 Type 2 trust center with third-party bias audits, but no public developer API surface yet.

providers.name: Gnowbe
providers.description: Gnowbe is an AI-powered workforce enablement and performance platform for enterprise learning, enablement, and alignment. It turns static content and communication into mobile-first microlearning experiences with AI-powered activation and execution tracking, so teams do not just learn but perform. Trusted by 500,000+ learners across 100+ countries, Gnowbe combines authoring, AI content creation, group-based delivery, completion and engagement analytics, and integrations (SSO/SAML, LMS/SCORM, xAPI/LRS, HR systems, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zapier's 5,000+ tools). Gnowbe is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Meisterwerk
providers.description: Meisterwerk is a modular all-in-one SaaS platform for German-speaking (DACH) trades and craft businesses (Handwerk), built by MEISTERWERK APP GmbH in Berlin. It gives small and medium craft firms (1-50 employees) a single operating system for job and resource scheduling (Einsatzplanung), a native mobile app for iOS, Android and Windows, chronological job documentation with photos and chat, quoting and invoicing with e-invoice support, EU-compliant mobile time tracking with GPS, digital forms and signatures, absence/holiday planning, and configurable workflows. AI features (planning assistant, speech-to-text documentation and time entry, and the standalone "Frag Maxi" phone assistant) are built in. It integrates with lexoffice, sevdesk, bexio and orgaMAX accounting software; a public open interface (Offene Schnittstelle) is announced but not yet publicly documented. Over 8,000 active users; data is hosted on servers in Germany and the platform is GDPR (DSGVO) compliant.

providers.name: Peppy
providers.description: Peppy is a global employee healthcare benefits platform, delivered through a mobile app, that connects workers with specialist clinicians across key life stages. Offered by employers as a benefit, Peppy provides unlimited access to practitioners covering women's health, men's health, fertility, pregnancy and early parenthood, menopause, and neurodiversity, alongside lifestyle support for nutrition, fitness, and mental wellbeing. Peppy operates a consumer and employer facing service and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its published web properties and security posture. Peppy is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Skuad
providers.description: Skuad is a global HR and employment platform (now part of Payoneer as Payoneer Workforce Management) that lets companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 160+ countries without setting up local legal entities. It provides employer-of-record (EOR) services, international payroll in 70+ currencies, contractor management and payments, benefits administration, background verification, and built-in compliance with local employment, tax, and labor laws. Skuad was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from Skuad's public web presence. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: TransparentBusiness
providers.description: TransparentBusiness is a New York based SaaS company, founded in 2012 by Alex Konanykhin and Silvina Moschini, that sells a cloud platform for managing and monitoring remote workforces: a desktop timer, screenshot-based activity verification, timesheets, task assignment, and real-time project cost and progress reporting for distributed teams and contractors. The company also operates the SheWorks! and Yandiki talent marketplaces and the CloudWorking Academy training platform, and was later renamed Unicoin, Inc. The product is delivered as a hosted web application plus downloadable desktop timer clients; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: VanHack
providers.description: VanHack is a SaaS hiring platform that connects employers with pre-screened senior software engineers from a global community of over 500,000 vetted candidates who are ready to relocate or work remotely. The platform pairs expert human recruiters with Vanna, an AI recruiter that matches candidates from natural-language job descriptions, and coordinates interviews with calendar sync, Slack, and ATS integration. VanHack reports 2,300+ hires at 520+ companies and charges a flat monthly fee with no placement fees. The company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Vela
providers.description: Vela is an AI scheduling assistant from Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch that handles the ambiguity that breaks scheduling. Added to any email thread or messaging conversation, it negotiates on the user's behalf — reading context, proposing meeting times across timezones, following up with participants, detecting calendar conflicts, rescheduling, and sending invites once scheduling is finalized. It works across Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is used by enterprise recruiters coordinating thousands of multi-party interviews a week as well as executives who need white-glove coordination at scale.

providers.name: Findem
providers.description: Findem is an AI Talent Intelligence platform that blends assistive AI for sourcing, marketing, executive search, and analytics with agentic AI workers for intelligent job posting, application boost, screening, and scheduling. The company also exposes Embedded AI building blocks (AI Job Board, Sourcing Copilot, Labeling Engine, Agents, and MCP) for partners to ship branded AI hiring experiences. Findem is sold enterprise-direct; ATS, HRIS, and partner integrations are gated rather than offered through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: HelloVerify
providers.description: HelloVerify is India's leading background verification (BGV) and employee screening company, delivering fast, accurate, and compliant primary-source verification for employment, education, healthcare credentialing, immigration, and enterprise workforce programs. The platform has completed 20M+ verifications for 2000+ organizations across 120+ countries, offering AI-powered background checks, customer KYC with identity and liveness, vendor due diligence (Certifier), and instant messaging-based verification (HelloV). HelloVerify operates an audited information-security and compliance program (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, Cyber Essentials, GDPR) and serves regulators, enterprises, SMBs, and applicants worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a dcvc portfolio company; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Indinero
providers.description: Indinero is a Finance-as-a-Service (FaaS) provider that combines professional accountants, tax experts, and fractional CFOs with AI-accelerated workflows to deliver outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, business tax preparation, payroll, 409A valuations, and on-demand financial support. Founded in 2009 and backed by 500 Global, the company serves startups through $500M+ revenue businesses across technology, SaaS, ecommerce, healthcare, construction, crypto, professional services, and non-profits, integrating primarily with QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. Indinero is SOC 2 compliant and delivers its services through a client portal (the indinero Exchange) rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Prescience Inc
providers.description: Prescience, Inc. is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) health benefits platform for employers, building "healthcare for the age of abundant intelligence." It uses machine-learning underwriting to design custom, largely self-insured health plans that aim to cut employer healthcare spend 20-50% versus traditional PEO and insurer plans, pairing $0-deductible coverage, included GLP-1 medications, wearables, and a 24/7 AI Care Companion for members. The company sells to employers, private-equity portfolios, and providers, and publicly attests to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance. As of this profile it exposes a marketing and member/employer web application only - no public API, developer portal, SDKs, MCP server, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: TransferRoom
providers.description: TransferRoom is football's real-time transfer marketplace, connecting clubs, agents and players to buy, sell and loan players and to recruit head coaches. Its API delivers verified, real-time market intelligence — Expected Transfer Value (xTV) benchmarks, player availability and deal-viability signals, contract-expiry and estimated-salary data, agent and coach representation, and head-coach ratings — returned as JSON for clubs to integrate directly into their own systems (SQL databases, BI dashboards, spreadsheets and code notebooks). Trusted by 800+ clubs across 130 leagues and 500+ agencies, covering 130,000+ players and 7,000+ head coaches, and powering 7,500+ transfer deals. The API is sales-gated: technical reference (endpoints, authentication, base URL) is provided to clubs on engagement and is not published publicly.

providers.name: Brigad
providers.description: Brigad is a French-founded staffing marketplace that connects verified, self-employed hospitality and healthcare professionals with businesses that need short-term cover. Founded in Paris in 2016 by Florent Malbranche, Jean Lebrument and Alexandre Rovetto, the platform pairs a talent app (for freelance chefs, waiters, bartenders, carers and nurses) with a business app (for restaurants, caterers, hotels, clinics, retirement homes and hospitals) and uses a matching algorithm to fill missions, often within hours. Brigad operates in France and the United Kingdom, has supported over 12,000 businesses and 23,000 independent professionals, and completed more than 300,000 missions. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Wendel, Serena and Square, having raised roughly €50 million to date. Brigad exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mona Ai
providers.description: Mona AI GmbH (mona-ai.de) is a German AI recruiting-automation company backed by Earlybird. Its platform combines AI agents and digital avatars to automate recruiting and HR processes for staffing agencies and enterprises: 24/7 candidate outreach, automated pre-qualification and candidate-profile generation, and "digital branch" structures — built to be fully GDPR- and EU-AI-Act-compliant. Products include MONA Recruiting, MONA Recruiting Light, MONA Agents, MONA Digital Branch, MONA Consulting and MONA ARS, an autonomous prompt-driven recruiting system that sources, screens, schedules and reports automatically. The website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for AI-agent access; the recruiting product itself runs behind a login and does not publish a public developer API, SDK or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Spill
providers.description: Spill is a UK-based employee assistance programme (EAP) that delivers mental health support to employees directly inside the tools teams already use, such as Slack and Microsoft Teams. The platform offers same-day, message-based counselling, structured multi-session therapy courses for specific mental health conditions, drop-in group sessions, manager mental-health training, and self-guided wellbeing content, all through a single subscription. Spill serves over 600 companies on month-to-month terms and is backed by Seedcamp. It is a B2B software-as-a-service wellbeing product rather than an API provider; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK has been published.
