The CHCO Council coordinates federal human capital management strategy, supports the Federal HR workforce, advances workforce planning and talent acquisition, and oversees performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and HR policy implementation across departments and agencies.

providers.name: Nava
providers.description: Nava (Nava Benefits) is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs benefits advisors with AI-powered technology to cut administrative work, simplify renewals, and support employees around the clock. Its HQ platform helps HR teams manage benefits and renewals while an employee app acts as a 24/7 digital benefits concierge for workers and their families, integrating with BenAdmin and carrier systems. Backed by Homebrew, Nava positions itself as an alternative to traditional brokers focused on cost savings and administrative relief. No public developer program, API, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Betterleap
providers.description: Betterleap is an AI-powered healthcare recruiting platform that automates candidate sourcing, credential verification, and multi-step outreach for talent acquisition teams. Its agentic search lets recruiters describe an ideal candidate conversationally and surfaces qualified matches from a database of 35M+ verified healthcare professionals, with licensing verified through 25+ state board partnerships. The platform autonomously drafts and sends personalized email sequences with follow-ups, integrates with ATS platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and UKG for talent rediscovery and data refresh, and reports recruiting performance and ROI through an insights dashboard. Betterleap is a venture-backed company (a16z portfolio) added to the API Evangelist network; it operates as a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Brightside
providers.description: Brightside (Brightside Benefit, Inc.) is an employer-sponsored financial care benefit that helps working families reduce everyday money stress. Delivered as an employee benefit through employers, Brightside pairs each employee with a human Financial Assistant and a mobile/web app offering emergency cash and loans, debt management and credit-score improvement, savings and early wage access, bill negotiation, crisis support (eviction, utilities, food), and guidance through major life events. The company is backed by a16z, Obvious Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Brightside is a consumer-facing benefits platform and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: CyberTalents
providers.description: CyberTalents is a global cybersecurity platform that ranks and connects security talent with employers based on real, hands-on skills. The platform automates Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, delivers cybersecurity courses and training camps, runs technical assessments for enterprises, and provides recruitment and headhunting services to close the global cybersecurity skills gap. Backed by 500 Global, CyberTalents operates from Egypt, the UAE, and the United States and hosts one of the largest cybersecurity practice communities in the world. This API Evangelist profile tracks CyberTalents as a company; no public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Easop
providers.description: Easop is a global equity compensation platform that helps startups and growing companies award and manage employee stock options and equity incentives across 70+ countries. It automates the legal workflows, board consents, country-specific tax and regulatory compliance, and employee education required to grant equity to international teams, and offers equity projection and compensation-grid planning plus integrations with cap-table tools such as Carta and Pulley. Easop was acquired by Remote in 2024. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company; Easop is a business SaaS application and publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Firstjob.me
providers.description: FirstJob (firstjob.me) is a Latin American employment platform founded in Chile in 2012 to improve working conditions for young professionals by connecting students and early-career candidates (0-2 years of experience) with entry-level jobs and internships at large employers. The platform lists 1,200+ active opportunities across engineering, administration, operations, and technology, maintains an employer directory, and runs networking events and webinars. It also operates related initiatives including Employers For Youth (EFY) and Best Internship Experiences (BIE) employer-ranking programs. FirstJob is a consumer-facing web platform used by more than 500,000 young professionals; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, SDKs, or a developer portal. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HeavyConnect
providers.description: HeavyConnect is a digital documentation and compliance platform purpose-built for agricultural operations, serving growers, harvesters, shippers, and processors. Its mobile-first, offline-capable modules cover food safety compliance, worker training and certification, time and productivity tracking, quality assurance inspections, end-to-end traceability, and supplier management. The platform replaces paper-based recordkeeping with audit-ready digital documentation and real-time analytics dashboards, helping food and agriculture operations stay inspection-ready. HeavyConnect reports 2,600+ active users across operations including Sysco, Naturipe, Talley, and Empire. It is offered as a month-to-month subscription with a request-a-demo onboarding path. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio-company lead (500 Global, Techstars) and enriched from the company's public web presence; no public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: JobToday
providers.description: JobToday is a mobile-first hiring marketplace that connects job seekers directly with employers for fast, chat-based hiring, primarily across service industries such as hospitality, retail, and customer service. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Luxembourg (JobToday S.A.), the app lets employers post jobs and message candidates directly, with the company reporting that roughly 70% of matches happen within 24 hours. JobToday operates across 20+ countries including the UK, US, Spain, Mexico, and France, and reports tens of millions of job seekers and hundreds of thousands of hiring businesses. It is backed by Accel. JobToday is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Magic
providers.description: Magic, Inc. is a Y Combinator-backed virtual assistant company that matches busy professionals, executives, and entrepreneurs with dedicated, vetted human assistants rather than AI bots. Through its Magic Match screening (assistants drawn from the top 0.5% of applicants), Magic 24/7 backup coverage, and ongoing training, the service handles email and inbox management, calendar and scheduling, travel planning, customer support, research, data entry, and other recurring business and personal tasks. Magic is a consumer- and business-facing staffing/concierge service delivered through a web workspace; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Manara
providers.description: Manara is an upskilling and professional development platform focused on the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, specializing in training for emerging technologies including AI and cloud computing. It runs enterprise workforce-development programs, national government training initiatives, and individual learning and certification courses, connecting a community of MENA software engineers and technologists with global career opportunities. The company reports 300,000+ learners trained, 2,500+ certifications awarded, operations across 40+ countries, and 500+ job placements. Manara publishes no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Onze
providers.description: Onze is a Brazilian fintech (São Paulo) focused on corporate private pension (previdência privada) and financial health for companies and their employees. It offers digital management of employer-sponsored pension plans, access to more than 300 investment funds, one-on-one financial consultations with specialists, and financial-education seminars, all delivered as a B2B employee benefits platform. Onze positions itself as the first fintech centered on pension and financial wellness for a company's collaborators, and is backed by Ribbit Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Onze publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Paraform
providers.description: Paraform is an agentic hiring marketplace where expert recruiters and custom AI agents work together to fill companies' most important roles. Companies post open roles and work with multiple vetted recruiters from a network of 10,000+ professionals in one place, while Paraform's AI toolkit handles sourcing, candidate matching, CRM, notetaking, and scheduling. The platform charges a listing (subscription) fee to publish roles and a success fee when a hire is made. Paraform does not publish a public developer API; instead it integrates into customers' existing ATS and productivity tools (Ashby, Greenhouse, Slack, Gmail, Calendly, Google Calendar) by consuming those partners' APIs and webhooks to keep candidate, role, and interview status in sync bidirectionally.

providers.name: Pintarnya
providers.description: Pintarnya is an Indonesian technology startup, launched in May 2022, that operates an employment and financial-services super-app for the country's blue-collar and entry-level workforce (education levels from elementary school through bachelor's degree, "SD-S1"). The platform aggregates tens of thousands of daily-updated job listings across 300+ Indonesian cities and pairs job search with Cari Cuan side-income tasks, Siap Kerja skill-building video courses, a CV builder, and an employer/recruiter posting product used by tens of thousands of companies. Pintarnya reports more than 10 million registered job seekers and is registered with Indonesia's Ministry of Labor (KEMNAKER). It is a consumer web and mobile product; no public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Powerplay
providers.description: Powerplay is a construction project management platform built by Coffer Internet Services Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, India) that gives builders, general contractors, subcontractors, project managers, and site engineers mobile and desktop tools to run construction projects end to end: real-time work and progress tracking, material procurement and inventory management, labor attendance and payroll, issue tracking, petty-cash and expense management, and reporting dashboards. The product is delivered primarily through iOS and Android field apps with a desktop companion. Powerplay does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation, so this profile captures its identity and web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Qwick
providers.description: Qwick is an AI-powered workforce management platform for the hospitality industry, connecting businesses with vetted hospitality professionals ("Pros") for on-demand shifts across 42 states. Its products span the Marketplace (intelligent shift matching), QwickGo (same-day shift posting), Jobs (performance-based hiring with paid working interviews), Compliance (scheduling and time-tracking rules enforcement), and Pay (multi-state W-2 and 1099 payroll). Qwick documents a REST API (v2) plus webhooks for custom integrations exposing shifts, pros, hours, invoices, and compliance data, and pre-built integrations with payroll (ADP, Gusto, Paychex, Paycom), POS (Toast, Square, Lightspeed), HRIS (Workday, BambooHR), scheduling (7shifts, Deputy, When I Work), and SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace). It is headquartered in Charleston, SC and backed by Foundry Group.

providers.name: Sabbar
providers.description: Sabbar is a leading local employment and recruitment platform in Saudi Arabia that connects job seekers with employers across many sectors. Job seekers search listings, build a free CV, and apply to roles, while employers use subscription-based recruitment packages and candidate matching. The platform reports more than 12,000 companies and over 1 million Saudi and non-Saudi job seekers, with iOS and Android mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Seso
providers.description: Seso is an all-in-one employee management platform built for U.S. agricultural operations, serving customers across all 50 states including 35 of the top 100 agricultural employers. Its software combines a modern farm HR system, compliant digital onboarding (I-9/W-4 with direct E-Verify integration), H-2A visa filing and compliance backed by legal resources, self-serve and managed payroll, and digital paycards for paycheck delivery. Seso also provides H-2A worker services such as consulate scheduling, recruiting, and logistics coordinated from its Monterrey, Mexico office. Backed by Bond Capital and Index Ventures. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Shakers
providers.description: Shakers is a Spanish technology platform — "the house of freeworking" — that connects enterprises with vetted, top-tier freelance developers and digital professionals. Its AI-powered products include Shakers AI (a copilot for project scoping and talent matching), Talent Insight (profile and skills analysis), Shakers Verified (technical verification of freelance profiles), and AI Interviews (automated candidate assessment). The platform serves 450+ enterprise clients including Telefónica, EY, BBVA, Microsoft, and HP across a community of 10,000+ tech freelancers. Backed by Partech, Shakers was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; as of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer web platform but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Summer
providers.description: Summer (Summer, PBC) is a financial wellness platform that helps individuals, employers, and government organizations manage student loan debt and education expenses. Summer connects members with 150+ federal and state loan programs to lower monthly payments, pursue loan forgiveness (including Public Service Loan Forgiveness), and build tax-advantaged education savings. It is delivered as an employee benefit and through public programs, offering debt optimization, college cost planning, tuition assistance, tax-favorable direct student-loan contributions, and retirement matching of loan payments. Summer reports over $2B in savings delivered and a 97% member satisfaction rate.

providers.name: TriNet
providers.description: TriNet is a Dublin, California-based professional employer organization (PEO) for small and mid-market businesses, founded in 1988 by Martin Babinec and led today by President and CEO Mike Simonds. TriNet delivers full-service HR through a co-employment model — payroll processing, Fortune-500-grade health, retirement and ancillary benefits, workers' compensation, employment-practices liability coverage, compliance and risk management, and strategic HR advisory — to thousands of SMBs across the United States. The company offers two main packages: TriNet PEO (full co-employment) and HR Plus (technology platform plus support). TriNet is publicly traded on the NYSE as TNET with trailing-twelve-month revenue of roughly $5.0B as of FY2025. TriNet exposes its HR Customer Platform through three SwaggerHub-documented API groups — DCP, HRIS, and PEO — covering Employees, Companies, Payroll, Money, and Time-Off domains, with API credentials issued to approved customers and Integration Center partners rather than offered as a fully open developer program; OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman/Insomnia collections, a sandbox, OAuth playground, and webhook management are available to authorized developers. Public 1:1 API access typically requires partner-program qualification and technical review, which is why most TriNet customers consume the platform via the curated Integration Center marketplace (accounting, HRIS, identity, ATS, payroll, benefits and learning partners) or via unified-API aggregators such as Finch, Merge, Apideck and Truto.

providers.name: wayup
providers.description: WayUp is a US early-career job and internship marketplace that connects college students and recent graduates with roles at 3,800+ vetted employers. Founded as Campus Job and rebranded WayUp in 2015, it was acquired by campus-recruiting company Yello in 2021. Candidates upload a resume and are matched to entry-level jobs, internships, and virtual career fairs, while employers use WayUp for early-talent sourcing and diversity recruiting. As of this profile WayUp publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its surface is a consumer web application plus a Help Scout knowledge base. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: A.Team
providers.description: A.Team is an enterprise AI talent network that connects companies with elite, pre-vetted tech builders — senior engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists — to design, build, and scale AI products and solutions. The platform matches Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups with dedicated talent and full cross-functional "expert teams," and increasingly delivers packaged AI agent solutions (voice agents, market-data and reporting agents, legal-document and due-diligence agents, municipal-code workflow agents) that integrate into existing tools like Slack, Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel. A.Team operates as a services and talent-marketplace business rather than a self-service developer API provider; it exposes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Apna
providers.description: Apna is India's leading professional networking and job-search platform, headquartered in Mumbai, India. Job seekers use Apna to search and apply to jobs online for free, join profession and location-based community groups, build a professional profile, and prepare for interviews, while employers post job vacancies and hire quality candidates in as little as 48 hours. Apna is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. At the time of this profile Apna does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this entry captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: BeyondHQ
providers.description: BeyondHQ is a distributed workforce planning platform that combines talent, cost, and location data to enable cross-functional decision making for hybrid and distributed teams. It equips HR, Real Estate, and Finance teams with a single, integrated experience that centralizes hiring and location-planning processes, providing real-time interactive comparisons across 500+ markets, 70,000+ searchable job skills, 750+ searchable occupations, and 50,000+ market-data combinations. The platform helps companies determine where to hire and physically locate their workforce using trusted, real-time data. BeyondHQ is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. BeyondHQ does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Happypal
providers.description: Happypal (HappyPal) is a Paris-based HR-tech and fintech company, founded in 2019, that operates the most widely used digital platform for French works councils (Comite Social et Economique, or CSE). The SaaS and payment platform lets CSE administrators distribute employee benefits and perks, manage budgets and accounting, run ticketing and gift-voucher (cheques-cadeaux) programs, and engage more than 500,000 beneficiaries through a mobile app. Happypal replaces paper gift vouchers with a dematerialized SaaS-plus-fintech model targeting France's employee-benefits market. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. Happypal does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and identity surface.

providers.name: Praxis Labs
providers.description: Praxis Labs is an AI-powered leadership and human-skills learning platform, surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and acquired by Torch. Its flagship product, Pivotal Practice, uses immersive simulations, personalized AI coaching, and role-play scenarios to build critical management capabilities such as difficult conversations and performance discussions, with behavior-change tracking and ROI analytics. The learning application runs at practice.praxislabs.co behind login and integrates with HR/L&D systems including Workday, Docebo, and Degreed. Praxis Labs is SOC 2 Type 2 certified. No public API, developer portal, or SDK was found during enrichment; this remains a company profile rather than an API provider.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Byteboard
providers.description: Byteboard is a technical interview platform for software engineering hiring. It replaces traditional whiteboard interviews with project-based, real-world assessments and live coding interviews that measure practical skills such as systems design, code quality, and communication across 20+ engineering competencies. Candidate work is anonymized and evaluated by trained human graders against calibrated rubrics to reduce bias and interviewer time while improving hire quality. Founded to fix the false positives, prep burden, and inequities of conventional coding interviews, Byteboard integrates with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse) and is now part of Karat. Byteboard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, domain security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: StanCorp Financial Group
providers.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. (doing business as The Standard) is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company since 2016. Founded in 1906, The Standard offers group and individual disability insurance, group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, group dental and group vision insurance, absence management services, retirement plans, individual annuities, and commercial mortgage loan origination. The Standard does not offer a public developer API. Employer and benefits administrator integrations are managed through EDI and proprietary data exchange channels.

providers.name: Assemble
providers.description: Assemble builds autonomous AI agents that help enterprise IT and business-systems teams automate development work inside core platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, and NetSuite. The agents scope changes across integrated ERP, CRM, and HRIS systems, understand cross-system dependencies, implement and validate modifications, and keep a complete audit trail so teams can review agent work, approve modifications, and revert individual changes or restore a system to a prior state. Assemble is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company targeting IT and business-systems teams managing complex enterprise transformations. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI, so only its verified public identity and website properties are captured.

providers.name: Bandana
providers.description: Bandana (operated by Workwise Solutions Inc.) is a two-sided marketplace and job-search platform for hourly and entry-level workers. Job seekers get free tools to find better-paying local jobs with benefits, generate resumes, auto-match to openings via Bandana Apply, and track applications; employers post jobs for free, reach local talent, promote listings across social platforms, and use a built-in ATS or integrate their existing hiring flow. Backed by Craft Ventures and General Catalyst, Bandana operates across California, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Chicago, and Washington, D.C. As of this profile Bandana publishes no public developer/API surface — no docs portal, OpenAPI, GitHub organization, or /.well-known discovery documents were found; this record captures its public identity and product links.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Cooleaf
providers.description: Cooleaf is an employee engagement, recognition, and rewards platform built by ITA Group that helps HR and people leaders create lasting engagement across their organizations. The platform lets teams recognize peers, reward performance and KPIs, celebrate milestones and anniversaries, run pulse surveys and challenges, deliver training and programming, and surface engagement analytics through manager dashboards. Cooleaf meets employees where they already work by embedding recognition into Slack and Microsoft Teams and syncing people data through connectors like Zapier and Workday. Cooleaf is delivered as a closed SaaS product with a hosted web application and login; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and the integration surface it exposes to customers rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Crowdplat
providers.description: CrowdPlat, Inc. is a Pleasanton, California company (backed by 500 Global) that operates two platforms combining human expertise with AI. Its crowdsourcing marketplace connects enterprises with vetted specialists across 50+ countries for consulting, software development, R&D, and innovation challenges, delivered with US-based project management and milestone-driven scopes. Its AI Hire platform is recruitment technology that automates candidate evaluation through resume scoring, AI-generated screening questions, video interviews, and LinkedIn job promotion with auto-targeted outreach. Customers include federal agencies and enterprises such as Airbus, PayPal, and EPRI. No public developer/API program is published at this time.

providers.name: Execthread
providers.description: ExecThread is a selective, invitation-based network where successful executives discreetly share confidential, recruiter-led job opportunities with one another that are not posted on public job boards. The membership platform matches vetted senior professionals with unadvertised executive-level roles, offers executive branding services and resume review, and runs a points-based referral economy for members who contribute opportunities. Founded as a private career marketplace, it has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 and by the Financial Times. It is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public API or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Gustav
providers.description: Gustav is a vendor management platform (VMS) and sub-vendor marketplace for the staffing industry, enabling staffing firms to source talent from their trusted vendor network, share open jobs, collect and screen candidate submissions, run standardized hiring pipelines, schedule interviews, message vendors, and track performance in one place. Vendors organize into "Gustav Circles" with tiered job-release controls, and candidate submissions sync to applicant tracking systems including Bullhorn and JobDiva. Originally a Speedinvest-backed startup, Gustav is now operated by the member-owned Fuse Cooperative (a Colorado Limited Cooperative Association) and bills itself as the staffing industry's largest sub-vendor marketplace. Gustav is a SaaS web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — integrations are delivered through the Bullhorn and JobDiva marketplaces.

providers.name: Jolly
providers.description: Jolly is an AI-powered workforce engagement platform that uses a points-based rewards system, gamification, and performance-based incentives to drive engagement, utilization, compliance, and recruitment for frontline and part-time workforces. Employees earn points by completing work-related missions (taking shifts, arriving on time, hitting productivity goals) and redeem them for real-world rewards from partners such as Walmart, Amazon, and Visa. Employers use an AI campaign builder, programmatic employee referrals, an internal social recognition platform, real-time analytics (flight-risk detection, employee NPS, engagement metrics via ERP/EMR integrations), and white-label branding. Jolly serves healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, staffing, farming, retail, warehousing, construction, and military employers. Based at Cornell Tech in New York City, the company raised a $16.5M Series A and is backed by Bullpen Capital along with executives from Tesla, Coinbase, Stripe, PayPal, and Discord. Jolly does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Reflex Careers
providers.description: Reflex (Reflex Careers) is an on-demand labor platform for retail stores, connecting brands and store operators with vetted, background-checked associates for short-notice shift coverage. The platform handles employer-of-record responsibilities including payroll, tax withholding, and compliance, lets retailers post shifts with as little as two hours' notice, and uses a two-way review system to build worker track records and brand-specific training per shift. Reflex serves retail brands including Ariat, Faherty, Fossil, and Everlane and is backed by Canaan Partners. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Canaan Partners portfolio; as of this enrichment pass Reflex publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: River Health
providers.description: River Health is an employer-sponsored virtual-first health plan operated by Mountain (joinmountain.com) that gives employees comprehensive primary and behavioral care at no cost to them. Members get unlimited virtual primary care and in-person doctor visits, behavioral health and therapy, thousands of free medications with home delivery or pharmacy pickup, free preventive care and screenings, after-hours urgent care, no-cost specialty and chronic- condition care, and free lab testing through Quest Diagnostics. Employers from small businesses to the Fortune 500 sponsor the plan; members enroll and manage care through the River Health member app at app.helloriver.com. River Health is a portfolio company of Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal has been published.

providers.name: Crosschq
providers.description: Crosschq is a hiring intelligence platform that helps talent acquisition and people-analytics teams improve quality of hire. Its cloud product suite spans AI-powered interview agents, automated reference checks, candidate assessment and screening, identity and interview-fraud detection, and quality-of-hire analytics that tie hiring decisions back to on-the-job outcomes. Crosschq connects to major applicant tracking and HCM systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Oracle, Lever, Ashby, Bullhorn, and others) through pre-built integrations rather than a public self-service API. Founded in Danville, California, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GGV Capital.

providers.name: Minu Holdings Limited
providers.description: Minu Holdings Limited operates minu.mx, Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform. Minu provides employers with more than fifty benefits designed to attract, retain, and engage talent, including on-demand salary access (earned wage access), savings accounts, food and gas vouchers, payroll-linked loans, telemedicine, insurance, discounts, and financial education programs. Backed by 500 Global, Minu delivers these services to employees through its mobile app and integrates with employer payroll and HR systems. No public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI specification was found during enrichment; the company operates a private/internal API surface (api.minu.mx responds but is not publicly documented).

providers.name: The Ladders
providers.description: Ladders (TheLadders.com) is a New York City based online job-search service founded in 2003 by Marc Cenedella that specializes in vetted executive and professional roles paying $100,000 or more per year. The subscription platform pairs a curated $100K+ job board with recruiter access, resume review and rewrite tools, AI-powered resume and LinkedIn optimization, and a daily career-news and advice product (Ladders News). It runs a consumer-facing web application with free Basic and paid Premium memberships and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or partner integration program.

providers.name: Standout
providers.description: Standout (standout.work) is an AI talent agent for tech professionals in the United States. Candidates run a CLI (`npx standout`) that assesses how they think, build, and debug to create a living, verified profile of capability rather than a resume. Standout matches candidates to hiring companies and brokers a direct introduction to the founder when a match looks right — no applications and no recruiter middle layer. It is free for candidates; companies pay only on a successful hire. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: Auditocity
providers.description: Auditocity is an HR compliance software platform that helps organizations of any size master regulatory requirements and best practices. It maintains a library of more than 14,000 questions spanning federal, state, and industry-specific HR compliance, automatically generating custom-built audits tailored to an organization's industry, size, and location. The platform produces actionable findings reports that identify compliance gaps, tracks requirements across all 50 states, and delivers real-time regulatory updates through an HR technology partner network. Auditocity is a Techstars portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been published at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Getsona
providers.description: Getsona (Sona) is an AI-powered workforce management platform that helps large, multi-site organizations make better workforce decisions across forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, HR, and payroll. Marketed as "AI for better workforce decisions," Sona serves enterprises in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics, with customers including Popeyes UK, Paul Bakery, Salutem Healthcare, and Liaise. The platform pairs operational scheduling with an enterprise app builder (Sona Forge) and a catalog of integrations, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, webhooks, or developer portal. Getsona is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Guild
providers.description: Guild (formerly Guild Education) is an education benefits and career opportunity platform that partners with large employers to fund and administer workforce education, upskilling, and career-mobility programs for their frontline and hourly employees. Employers offer Guild as a benefit; employees access a curated marketplace of degrees, certificates, bootcamps, English-language, and professional-skilling programs from vetted learning providers, plus coaching and career navigation to move into higher-demand roles. Guild is a B2B/B2B2C SaaS platform sold to enterprise HR and talent-development teams to fill critical roles, improve retention, increase internal mobility, and prove measurable ROI. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Guild is a venture-backed company. This profile was surfaced from investor portfolios and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Guild publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Helio AI LLC
providers.description: Helio AI LLC operates Helio.AI, an AI-powered recruiting and applicant tracking (ATS) platform for HR and talent-acquisition teams. It automates the end-to-end hiring workflow — job posting and distribution, resume screening, candidate tracking, real-time analytics, and team collaboration — and pairs the ATS with a gamified personality test to evaluate candidates. The product is offered in multiple languages (English, Russian, Georgian, Armenian, Azerbaijani, and Uzbek) and targets markets across Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Uzbekistan. Helio AI is backed by 500 Global. The company runs its customer application at app.helio-ai.com and does not currently publish a public developer API program or documentation.

providers.name: Nexus AI
providers.description: Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as "Nexus AI", a 500 Global portfolio lead, but its recorded domain conceptdrop.com now permanently redirects (301) to hiresource.io — the site of Source (formerly ConceptDrop), a freelance creative-talent management platform. Source lets teams find, vet, and manage freelance designers, writers, animators, and consultants through a single contract with a dedicated account manager, replacing traditional creative-agency procurement. The customer application lives at app.hiresource.io; the public site is a WordPress marketing property. During enrichment no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — this remains a non-API company profile.

providers.name: OnMyGrad
providers.description: OnMyGrad is a Hong Kong-based campus-recruitment and career-learning SaaS platform that helps employers connect with university talent across Southeast Asia through virtual job-tasting and work-experience programs. Founded in 2021 by Jesse Chow and Chun Hin Anthony So, its B2B2C "OnMyGrad Space" lets employers build branded profiles, run virtual talent pipelines, and evaluate candidates, while students access immersive career and industry learning content from leading employers. The company launched its MVP in February 2021, raised pre-seed funding from 500 Global, and is expanding into Singapore and Taiwan. It operates a public marketing site and a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Edme Insurance Brokers
providers.description: Edme Insurance Brokers Ltd (formerly Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, ABIBL) is an India-based composite insurance broker offering corporate, retail, and reinsurance solutions across 30+ industries including aviation, marine, energy, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, technology, and the BFSI and FMCG sectors. The company provides tailored risk management, employee benefits, and claims advisory services, backed by digital customer portals for policy and claims management and employee benefits. Edme is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Edme publishes no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Nuevo Método
providers.description: Nuevo Método (NUME) is an international digital-health and corporate-wellness platform, headquartered in Mexico City and operating across 17 countries in Latin America and Europe. It helps insurers and enterprises deliver personalized wellbeing benefits to employees, customers, and their families across three pillars: mental health (psychology sessions, mindfulness, meditation, sleep tracking), physical health (24/7 virtual medical consultations, fertility guidance, menstrual-cycle tracking, health workshops), and lifestyle (personal-finance courses, financial advisory, and inspirational talks). The company runs a fully remote workforce and reports measurable client outcomes such as improved sleep, productivity, and employee retention. Founded and led by Dr. Ingrid Briggiler (CEO). No public API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Reliance Health
providers.description: Reliance Health (formerly RelianceHMO) is a healthtech company making quality healthcare accessible and affordable across emerging markets, with operations centered in Nigeria and expanding across Africa and the Middle East. It offers employer-sponsored and individual health plans covering preventative, emergency, and chronic care, telemedicine and doctor consultations through its mobile app, and a network of 3,800+ healthcare partners (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and diagnostic centers). Reliance Health combines insurance, its own clinics, and technology to deliver an end-to-end care experience for businesses and their employees. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the reliancehmo.com application backend (api.reliancehmo.com) is an internal web-app origin, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Stride Health
providers.description: Stride Health is a benefits platform that helps independent, gig, and part-time workers access portable benefits that stay with the individual regardless of where or how they work. Stride connects people to affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and provides tax tools, mileage/expense tracking, and savings features for the self-employed. The company reports 4.6 million independent workers served, $8+ billion saved on insurance and taxes, and 130+ partner companies. Stride operates a private B2B partner integration (embedded in partner apps such as gig-work platforms) but publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Nava Benefits
providers.description: Nava Benefits is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs expert human advisors with AI-driven technology to help HR teams manage health insurance renewals, audit billing, control benefits costs, and improve the employee experience. Its platform includes "HQ for HR" for benefits administration, renewals, and document management, and "HQ for Employees" for 24/7 benefits support, plan-decision tools, provider search, and digital ID cards, backed by consultants advising on self-funding and captive strategies. Surfaced as a gv portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; this enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Backstartup
providers.description: Backstartup is a Colombian tech-enabled accounting and legal services firm for startups and small businesses (notably SAS entities). It automated company formation, bookkeeping, tax filing, payroll, and legal/DIAN compliance for founders in Latin America. Backstartup has since been integrated into Numbi (numbi.ai), a tech-enabled accounting firm that operates monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN compliance on top of the accounting systems companies already use (Siigo and Alegra), pairing expert accountants with automation and AI. Backstartup's legacy domain (backstartup.com) now redirects to numbi.ai and Backstartup operates as a sub-organization within Numbi's Colombia operation. This is a services-company profile: no public developer API or OpenAPI is published. It entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Gebeya
providers.description: Gebeya is an Ethiopian talent-cloud and marketplace technology company headquartered in Addis Ababa, founded in 2016 by Amadou Daffe and Hiruy Amanuel. It trains, vets, and connects African tech talent with organizations, and provides a Marketplace-as-a-Service platform (Gebeya-Jenga) that lets entrepreneurs launch branded, multi-tenant service marketplaces with built-in payments and analytics. Its current products include Dala Studio and Jitume, applying LLMs and proprietary data to build AI agents and workforce-intelligence tools for the African digital economy. Gebeya is backed by Partech. As of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.

providers.name: Miso Robotics
providers.description: Miso Robotics is a Pasadena, California kitchen-automation company that builds AI-powered robotics and restaurant operations software for commercial food service. Its flagship product, Flippy, is an autonomous fry station that uses computer vision and NVIDIA-accelerated motion planning to identify food items, detect doneness and run up to 100 baskets per hour on existing commercial fryers from Frymaster, Henny Penny and Pitco. Miso also ships Zippy (built on the acquired Zignyl platform), a real-time digital shift manager for forecasting, scheduling, task management, incentives and payroll that connects to restaurant point-of-sale systems. Customers include White Castle, Jack in the Box, CaliBurger and Auntie Anne's. Miso publishes no public developer API, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract and no SDKs; its integrations are delivered as private partner connections (Toast, PAR and other POS vendors) arranged through sales, and its public GitHub organization carries ROS/robotics and cloud-infrastructure forks used internally rather than a client-facing API surface.

providers.name: VidCruiter
providers.description: VidCruiter is a Moncton, Canada based recruitment technology company that provides a modular hiring platform - pre-recorded and live video interviewing, automated interview scheduling, skills and pre-employment testing, automated reference checking, audio interviews, and video proctoring. VidCruiter does not publish a public, self-service developer API. Its programmatic surface is a partner and enterprise integration capability: pre-built connectors to major ATS/HCM, background-check, calendar, job-board, SSO, and video-conferencing providers, plus a bidirectional web-services integration in which an institution's unique, account-provisioned API endpoint is exchanged with a system of record (for example Slate) to push application records into VidCruiter and pull completed interview results back out. API access is gated behind a VidCruiter account representative; there is no public API reference, OpenAPI document, base URL, or self-serve key issuance.

providers.name: Aura Finance
providers.description: Aura Finance is an employer-sponsored financial wellness platform that blends behavioral psychology with money management to help employees reach financial stability and peace of mind. The San Francisco fintech — a Techstars Economic Mobility 2023 company and an SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD 318940) — delivers goal-based automated investing, one-on-one financial coaching over chat, budgeting and saving tools, financial-literacy workshops, mindfulness exercises to reduce money stress, and a money-personality quiz, offered through a B2B2C model to organizations and their workforces. The company publishes no public developer program, API, or SDKs; its member application lives at web.aurafi.io.

providers.name: Crew
providers.description: Crew is a digital workplace platform for frontline and deskless teams, connecting frontline staff to corporate leadership across distributed workforces. The product bundles real-time team communication and employee engagement, labor optimization and shift scheduling, task execution, culture and recognition, knowledge management, a Command Center for administration and analytics, a compliance and safety suite, and third-party integrations. Crew reports serving more than one million frontline workers across companies including Taco Bell, Wendy's, Planet Fitness, and Harps Foods. It is backed by Greylock and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: EarnBetter
providers.description: EarnBetter is a consumer job-search platform that gives workers free AI-powered tools to land better work, including an AI resume builder, cover letter generator, personalized job matching across more than five million listings, and a job-search tracker. The service is positioned as 100% free to job seekers and was acquired by EarnIn, the earned-wage / payroll-access company. EarnBetter surfaces as a portfolio company of a16z and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this pass EarnBetter publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore captures company identity and public link properties only, with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Moonhub
providers.description: Moonhub is an AI recruiting platform that deploys proprietary AI agents to source, qualify, engage, and vet candidates across millions of profiles, helping companies hire faster and more cost-effectively. Its agent products (Qualify AI, Engage AI, and Monitor AI) automatically identify qualified candidates, run outreach to convert them into interview-ready applicants, and analyze candidate intent to manage recruiter handoffs. Moonhub is backed by Khosla Ventures, GV, Greycroft, Time Ventures, and AIX Ventures; the Moonhub team joined Salesforce in 2026. The company ships a recruiter web application (recruiter.moonhub.ai) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Perfectly
providers.description: Perfectly is an AI-native recruiting platform (Y Combinator W2026) that automates the hiring process end to end, from candidate sourcing and outreach through screening and qualification. Its employer-facing AI recruiting agent, Paul, sources, engages, and qualifies candidates to help startups fill roles in days rather than weeks, delivered as an AI-native recruiting agency paired with a forward-deployed recruiter for onboarding and configuration. Its job-seeker agent, Parker, is an AI career super-connector on iMessage and WhatsApp that helps candidates find relevant industry contacts and craft personalized outreach before roles are publicly posted. Founded by former ML scientists and engineers from Meta and TikTok, Perfectly operates as a chat- and agent-delivered hiring service rather than a public developer API; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: ContinuumCloud
providers.description: ContinuumCloud is a Tampa, Florida-based provider of cloud software purpose-built for behavioral health and human services organizations. Its integrated suite spans three products: Welligent, an electronic health record (EHR) platform for caseload management, scheduling, clinical documentation and revenue-cycle management; DATIS e3, a unified human capital management (HCM) and payroll system covering recruiting, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management and workforce analytics; and CaredFor, a patient-engagement platform that builds online communities connecting clients, alumni and families. Formerly known as Behavioral Holdings and founded in 2020, the company draws on 25+ years of domain focus and is backed by Battery Ventures. ContinuumCloud does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or MCP server at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Qualifi
providers.description: Qualifi is a recruiting and hiring platform that streamlines candidate screening through asynchronous, voice-based phone interviews, automated scheduling, and live video interviews. Recruiters send candidates a pre-recorded phone screen, review responses on their own schedule, and move qualified applicants forward faster, reducing time-to-hire while keeping the candidate experience high. Qualifi offers 50+ applicant tracking system (ATS) integrations, a "Qualifi Copilot" that surfaces the tool directly inside your ATS, and Google/Microsoft calendar sync. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: Well
providers.description: Well is a personalized health engagement platform for employers and their workforce, marketed as "your personalized daily health partner." It pairs an AI-driven health engine that delivers tailored interventions and behavior-change nudges with human "Well Guides," across a mobile and web experience, and ties outcomes to a performance-based ROI guarantee for the sponsoring employer. Well powers wellness programs, health challenges, biometric screenings, premium reductions, and rewards for large employer and benefits clients including Bank of America, USAA, Sam's Club, UNC Health, MGM, Regions, Amentum, and Octapharma. The company is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; enrichment found a public WordPress marketing/campaign presence at well.co but no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Skello
providers.description: Skello is a European (French) workforce management SaaS for shift-based businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and health. It provides employee scheduling and shift planning, time and attendance tracking, absence and leave management, labor-cost and legal-compliance controls, team communication, and payroll preparation exports. Skello is a Partech portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Skello publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or status page; integrations are delivered through its own partner program rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Artemis Health
providers.description: Artemis Health (now Artemis by Nomi Health) is a healthcare data analytics platform that helps employers, benefits advisors, and health plans see every healthcare dollar clearly, cut waste, and improve care for their members. The platform unifies medical, pharmacy, and other benefits data to deliver cost analysis, program evaluation, automated reporting, custom analytics, and social-determinants-of-health insights for self-insured organizations. Artemis was acquired by Nomi Health in 2022. The product is a login-gated B2B SaaS application; no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface is published. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and enriched with the verifiable public identity, link, and domain-security signals available.

providers.name: Beam Dental
providers.description: Beam Dental (Beam Benefits) is an employee benefits provider offering dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental health coverage (accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness) to brokers, employers, and members. The company streamlines benefits administration with digital quoting, self-service member, broker, and provider portals, and fast group implementation. Beam is backed by Kleiner Perkins. As of this enrichment pass Beam publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification; its digital surface is a set of login-gated member, broker/employer (Lighthouse), and provider web applications.

providers.name: Equitable
providers.description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. is a financial services holding company offering individual retirement, group retirement, life insurance, and employee benefits solutions. In 2025, Equitable launched API capabilities for benefits plan setup integration, partnering with platforms such as Employee Navigator to streamline broker workflows.

providers.name: Gridwise
providers.description: Gridwise is an earnings-tracking and optimization platform for rideshare and delivery gig workers, aggregating mileage, trip, and income data across gig platforms such as Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Grubhub, Instacart, and Amazon Flex so drivers can see where they earn most and drive more strategically. Alongside the consumer app, Gridwise operates Gridwise Analytics, a B2B mobility-data business that turns millions of anonymized driver location, trip, and earnings records into industry benchmarking, KPI, and market-intelligence products for gig mobility platforms, financial services, retailers/merchants, and autonomous vehicle fleets. Data is delivered as aggregated weekly reports, record-level trip datasets, and consumer/driver surveys through commercial engagement. Gridwise does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its consumer, data-product, support, and policy surfaces.

providers.name: Howdy
providers.description: Howdy is a nearshore talent platform that connects US companies with senior software engineers, data, DevOps, design, and product professionals across Latin America. Operating as an employer of record (EOR), Howdy handles recruiting, vetting, payroll, benefits, equipment, compliance, and team performance coaching through physical "Howdy Houses" in cities across the region. Founded in 2018 in Austin, Texas by Jacqueline Samira and Frank Licea, the company went through Y Combinator (W21) and acquired the Brazilian recruiting platform GeekHunter in 2023. It is a services/staffing business with no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, agent-facing, and legal surface.

providers.name: Paynas
providers.description: Paynas is an Egyptian HR, payroll, and employee-benefits platform offering hassle-free, digitized human-resources management for businesses. Through a single web and mobile interface, Paynas handles attendance tracking, vacation and leave management, payroll processing, and reporting analytics, while extending financial services to employees through the Paynas Card — a Visa-powered payroll card issued in partnership with Banque Misr — and affordable medical-insurance packages provided in partnership with Libano-Suisse. Backed by 500 Global, the company serves employers across Egypt. Paynas publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lightcast
providers.description: Lightcast (formerly Emsi Burning Glass) provides labor market data and analytics including the Career Coach Careers API, a RESTful service that contains economic data for careers stored in JSON format.

providers.name: Bonum Coaching
providers.description: Bonum Coaching is an enterprise coaching platform based in Latin America that pairs personalized human coaching with technology to develop talent and improve organizational performance. Its offering spans one-to-one executive coaching, group and team coaching, structured mentoring programs, and CLARA, an AI coach-bot for practicing workplace conversations in a safe environment. The company positions itself around democratizing access to coaching, leadership development, talent retention, building a growth culture, and diversity, equity and inclusion, and counts enterprises such as Uber, Davivienda, Farmatodo, and Mi Banco among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Bonum Coaching is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Compt
providers.description: Compt is an employee benefits platform that automates flexible stipends and Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs). HR teams define eligible categories across 30+ benefit types — wellness, childcare, professional development, and more — while employees submit receipts for reimbursement. The platform automatically handles taxable versus nontaxable treatment and delivers payments through existing payroll, alongside rewards and recognition, professional development management, employee discounts, a company swag store, and business expense tracking. Compt reports a 93% average participation rate and roughly 30 minutes of monthly admin time. It is a Battery Ventures portfolio company. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Medley
providers.description: Medley is a leadership development company that delivers group-based executive coaching at enterprise scale, pairing professional coaches with AI-enabled tooling to bring quality and a human touch to Fortune 500 organizations. Founded in 2020 by Edith Cooper and Jordan Taylor, the platform runs curated small-group coaching cohorts focused on trust, empathy, communication, and collaboration to drive organizational transformation. Medley raised a $3.7M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). It operates as a B2B services and coaching platform and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Spokn
providers.description: Spokn is an AI-powered short-form video creation platform built for internal communications, HR, and learning & development teams. It lets organizations collect selfie, full-screen, or screen-share clips from employees across desktop and mobile, then stitch, trim, caption, translate (15 languages), and brand them into polished employee videos in under 30 minutes without video-editing expertise. Finished videos distribute via intranet, LMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, or MP4 export. Spokn integrates with common HRIS (BambooHR, Workday, Zenefits, ADP, Rippling), SSO (Okta, OneLogin, G Suite), and Slack, but does not currently publish a public developer API, API reference, or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: HERP
providers.description: HERP Inc. (株式会社HERP) is a Japanese HR Tech company whose mission is "採用を変え、日本を強く。" (change recruiting, strengthen Japan). It builds HERP Hire, an AI-era applicant tracking and recruitment management system (ATS) known for "scrum recruiting", alongside ジョブミル (Jobmill) for recruiting agents and HERP Career, a startup-focused job-change service. HERP Hire integrates with job boards and tools such as Zoom, Google Calendar and Slack, and exposes the "HERP Hire API" (generally available from 2026-02-03 to paying customers) for member assignment and application management. HERP was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: Take2.ai
providers.description: Take2.ai builds autonomous AI agents purpose-built for healthcare recruiting, automating the end-to-end hiring workflow from candidate sourcing through screening, interviewing, credential verification, and scheduling. Its product suite includes an AI Interviewer that conducts 24/7 phone interviews and syncs scoring and transcripts back into the recruiter's system, an AI Sourcer that re-engages past applicants to build pipelines for hard-to-fill clinical roles, an AI Verifier for real-time credential and certification checks, and an AI Scheduler for interview coordination. The platform integrates with most ATS and HRIS systems, is hosted on AWS in the United States, and is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Take2.ai is a Techstars-backed company serving enterprise healthcare organizations. As of this profile the company exposes a customer-facing SaaS product and ATS/HRIS integrations but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: LIMRA
providers.description: LIMRA is a member-based research and trade association for the life insurance and financial services industry, operating alongside LOMA under the LL Global umbrella. It provides industry research, sales and market data, benchmarking, experience studies, and professional development to member companies - primarily life insurers, annuity providers, and workplace benefits carriers. LIMRA does not operate a public developer API or developer portal. Its research, benchmarking, and experience-study data are delivered through the member-gated LIMRA.com portal, reports, and consortium programs rather than a programmatic interface. LIMRA's most API-relevant offering is the LIMRA Data Exchange (LDEx) Standards - free, industry-developed data exchange standards for workplace benefits (benefits enrollment management, benefits configuration management, and evidence of insurability) that define payloads in XML and JSON and, in recent releases, REST endpoints specified in OpenAPI 3.1. LDEx is a specification that insurance carriers and benefits administration platforms implement between themselves; LIMRA publishes the standard (registration required to download, membership not required) but does not host any live endpoints. This entry is an honest documentation stub kept for catalog completeness; it will be updated if LIMRA ever ships a hosted public API.

providers.name: Come Bien
providers.description: Come Bien is a Mexican foodtech company operating a digital corporate cafeteria (comedor digital) that delivers fresh, home-style, nutritionally balanced meals to offices without requiring any on-site kitchen installation. Employees choose from a rotating seven-week cyclical menu each day, place their order through the Come Bien app, and receive individually bagged, ready-to-eat meals delivered to the workplace in 100% biodegradable packaging. A dedicated backoffice platform lets employers subsidize, administer, and gain full visibility into their team's food benefit. Backed by 500 Global, the company reports serving 100+ companies, 10,000+ employees, and more than 1.5M orders delivered.

providers.name: sherpa
providers.description: sherpa is an AI operating system for External Workforce Management (EWM) that runs an enterprise's contingent-labor program end to end with autonomous agents, replacing the work traditionally done by a VMS (Vendor Management System) and MSP (Managed Service Provider). Its agents cover every phase of an external engagement: autonomous intake and classification from Slack, email, Teams or voice; collaborative scope, role and budget drafting; autonomous sourcing with market-benchmarked rates and ranked candidates and suppliers; coordinated screening interviews scored against a weighted rubric; autonomous hiring and onboarding (documents, background and compliance checks, contracts, provisioning, hardware and badges); and active management and payment with a dedicated PM agent, live spend visibility and flexible payouts once outcomes are verified. One platform spans every worker type — contingent labor, freelancers / independent contractors (with a built-in Agent of Record), SOW / services engagements, and, coming soon, AI agents as a managed worker type — with rate intelligence, compliance management and analytics built in. sherpa launched out of stealth with a $2.2M pre-seed round and is backed by Seedcamp and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Squadio
providers.description: Squadio is a Tech Teams as a Service (TaaS) platform, backed by 500 Global, that lets companies spin up dedicated squads of vetted software engineers and tech talent to build, scale, and digitally transform their projects. The platform covers hiring tech talent, payroll management, MVP development, and talent buyout, and pairs clients with talent through an assisted onboarding flow that includes its Lama AI assistant. Squadio operates primarily across the MENA region and connects businesses with remote engineering teams rather than exposing a public developer API.

providers.name: Swing Education
providers.description: Swing Education is a technology-driven substitute teacher staffing marketplace for K-12 schools and districts across the United States. Its vetted platform connects schools and districts with qualified, background-checked substitute teachers and classified staff to cover daily absences, long-term leaves, special education classrooms, and paraprofessional roles. Schools request coverage through an online admin console while substitutes browse and claim assignments through a dedicated app. The company reports a 94% fill rate, an average five-minute fill time, and coverage of more than 6,000 schools. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; the public site exposes no developer/API surface, so this record carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Asap Work
providers.description: Asap.work is a next-generation temporary staffing, permanent placement, and freelance recruitment platform for the French construction and skilled-trades sector (BTP - Batiment et Travaux Publics). It connects tradespeople with short-term missions, permanent roles, and freelance projects through a mobile app and a network of consultants, and layers on worker benefits such as housing assistance, medical consultations, training via asap.academy, and wage advances. The company is backed by speedinvest and is expanding toward the United States. Asap.work publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and, on enrichment, was confirmed to have no machine-readable API surface (searched 2026-07-18).

providers.name: CareGuide
providers.description: CareGuide is a Canadian company operating a network of online marketplaces that connect families with caregivers across child care, home care, pet care, and elder care, alongside HeartPayroll household payroll services. Its consumer brands include CanadianNanny.ca, Sitter.com, PetSitter.com, ElderCare.com, HouseKeeper.com and a family of "Meet A" professional directories. Backed by 500 Global, CareGuide is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The company does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CodeMentor
providers.description: CodeMentor (codementor.io) is an on-demand marketplace that connects software developers with vetted expert mentors for live 1:1 coding help, code review, debugging, pair programming, and longer-term freelance engagements across dozens of programming languages and frameworks. Part of the Arc / CodeMentor group, it serves individual learners seeking real-time mentorship as well as companies hiring vetted remote developers. As of this profile CodeMentor exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; this record was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: conrizon
providers.description: conrizon AG is a German holding company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Essen, that unites four of Europe's leading Enterprise Content Management (ECM) brands - easy software, PROXESS, HABEL, and Portal Systems (Shareflex), alongside the friendWorks professional-services unit - under one roof. The group provides legally compliant, audit-proof digital archiving (GDPR, GoBD, eIDAS), document management (DMS), invoice and procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, contract management, and HR/HCM software with automated workflows, plus AI services and connectors for SAP and Microsoft 365 / SharePoint. Solutions are offered cloud-native, in a private cloud, on-premises, or hybrid, and are relied on by more than 8,700 companies and organizations worldwide. conrizon is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Guild Education
providers.description: Guild is an education benefits platform that helps large employers turn workforce education into workforce strategy. Guild connects a company's frontline and hourly workers to a curated marketplace of debt-free education, upskilling, and career-development programs delivered through vetted learning partners (universities, bootcamps, and skilling providers), and pairs that access with coaching and analytics so HR leaders can fill critical roles, improve retention, increase internal mobility, and prove measurable ROI. Guild operates as a B2B2C platform: employers fund and administer the benefit, learning partners supply the programs, and members (employees) enroll and progress toward degrees, certificates, and new durable skills. Guild does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company and web-property surface.

providers.name: Mochacare
providers.description: MochaCare is an AI-powered operations platform for home care agencies and care facilities, combining human virtual assistants with AI agents to run hiring, scheduling, and client-intake operations end-to-end. The company offers two products: Mocha Managed, a 24/7 managed service where its team handles hiring and scheduling, and Mocha Tools, an AI software platform featuring an applicant tracking system, automated shift scheduling, shift-coverage management, document collection, and growth analytics. MochaCare builds custom integrations with existing care-agency systems (WellSky, AxisCare, AlayaCare), plus hiring and communication tools (Indeed, RingCentral), but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. A Y Combinator portfolio company founded by Nick Walker and Pranav Uppiliappan.

providers.name: Onsitedental
providers.description: Onsite Dental is a mobile and on-site dental care provider that brings full-scope oral healthcare directly to employers and their employees at the workplace. It operates three delivery models: fixed-site practices built inside client buildings, mobile dental clinics deployed to larger corporate campuses, and pop-up practices set up temporarily in conference rooms or amenity centers. Services span cleanings, preventive and diagnostic care, and full treatment delivered by dentists, hygienists, and specialists, positioned as an employee benefit for large employers and their benefits consultants. Onsite Dental is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Ovia Health
providers.description: Ovia Health (by Labcorp) is a digital women's and family health platform delivering evidence-based programs, personalized data insights, and Care Team support across reproductive health, fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and menopause. It is offered to individuals through consumer mobile apps (Ovia, Ovia Pregnancy, Ovia Fertility) and to employers and health plans as a benefit, and its apps sync with consumer health platforms including Apple Health and Google Fit. Ovia Health does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and reflects the honest result of an enrichment pass that found no public API surface, only a consumer/enterprise product.

providers.name: Rightway Healthcare
providers.description: Rightway Healthcare is a healthcare navigation and pharmacy benefits management (PBM) company that pairs a transparent, 100% pass-through PBM built by pharmacists with clinical care navigation that helps members understand their benefits, resolve billing questions, and connect with the right care. Rightway serves employers and their members through web and mobile apps rather than a public developer program.
