This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of khosla-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Rightway publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so the captured artifacts are limited to a domain-security probe and verified public web properties.

providers.name: ShiftSouth
providers.description: ShiftSouth (Pty) Ltd operates SweepSouth, South Africa's first on-demand home services marketplace, launched in 2014. The platform connects roughly 250,000 customers with about 6,500 vetted home-services professionals ("SweepStars") across Cape Town, Johannesburg, Sandton, Centurion, Pretoria, Durban, Umhlanga, Stellenbosch, Paarl and other South African cities. Services span on-demand and express indoor cleaning, office and Airbnb turnover cleaning, laundry and ironing, elder care, Mom's Helper and childcare, dog walking, gardening and pool maintenance, plus full-time placements of housekeepers, nannies and carers and a MyHome Hub subscription for managing private domestic workers. Professionals are background-checked, reference-verified and insured. SweepSouth is a 500 Global portfolio company and has won the Forbes Africa Women Innovation Award (2020) and the World Economic Forum Breakthrough Female Innovators Award (2017). It is a consumer marketplace with mobile apps for iOS and Android and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Slik
providers.description: Slik is a Latin American employee experience (PX) platform that helps organizations measure, analyze, and activate employee engagement in real time. Its Engagement module runs collaborator-journey surveys with real-time reporting, AI-prioritized improvement opportunities, people analytics and prediction, and leader action plans across the selection, onboarding, climate, and wellbeing touchpoints; its Performance module tracks cascading OKRs and continuous feedback outside annual review cycles. Slik distributes surveys and reaches employees through messaging channels including Slack, Google, Microsoft Teams, Workplace, and WhatsApp. Founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina and backed by 500 Global/500 Latam, AVP Ventures, and Vulcano Fund, the platform serves large enterprises such as Burger King, AXA, DHL, Starbucks, and Dole. Slik does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Medwing
providers.description: MEDWING is Germany's largest digital service platform for jobs and staffing in the healthcare sector, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Berlin. It operates a recruitment marketplace that matches hospitals, clinics and care facilities with nurses, caregivers, doctors, midwives, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals across Germany and the United Kingdom. Beyond permanent placement, MEDWING combines career brokerage with temporary-staffing (Zeitarbeit) operations and HR/workforce tooling, offering an end-to-end digital workflow that spans job search, matching, contracts, digital signatures and timesheets. The service is free for candidates, with employers paying on successful placement. MEDWING is backed by Northzone and other investors. This profile was enriched from public web sources; MEDWING does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Virtual Internship Partners
providers.description: Virtual Internships (Virtual Internship Partners) is a global EdTech platform that connects learners, universities, and host companies to deliver guaranteed remote internships across career fields including finance, legal, healthcare, media and communications, supply chain, hospitality, real estate, HR, and sustainability. Backed by 500 Global, it pairs students and graduates with mentored, project-based work experience at companies worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing website and a Rank Math llms.txt but exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Jobvetta
providers.description: Jobvetta is a jobs API for India — live openings gathered and checked against official employer sources, exposed as a REST API and a hosted MCP server that share one key. Search by keyword, Indian city or state, and posting age; fetch full structured detail for a single job. It is India-only by design: non-Indian locations return no results. The MCP server answers tools/list without credentials, so an agent can discover the two tools before signing up, and installation is a single documented `claude mcp add` command. Free during early access, with a shared limit of 50 tool calls per day and up to 20 jobs per search across both surfaces.

providers.name: BrightGo
providers.description: BrightGo is an all-in-one janitorial and commercial-cleaning ERP platform for building service contractors. It unifies field operations, workforce management, and back-office finance in one system: scheduling, GPS-verified time and attendance, inspections and quality assurance, real-time job costing, payroll, and accounting, plus operations business-intelligence dashboards and an in-app employee communication portal. Backed by Index Ventures and Costanoa Ventures, BrightGo serves janitorial companies across the U.S. and Canada. No public developer API or documentation surface has been identified; the product is delivered via web (app.brightgo.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps.

providers.name: 51job
providers.description: 51job (前程无忧) is one of China's largest online recruitment and human resource services platforms, operated by 51job, Inc. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Shanghai, the company connects job seekers and employers through its flagship 51job.com website and mobile apps, alongside enterprise hiring services (ehire.51job.com), campus recruitment, HR outsourcing, training, and assessment offerings. Formerly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker JOBS, 51job was taken private in 2022 by an investor consortium that included DCM, Ocean Link, and company management. 51job does not publish a public developer API or open platform; partner and applicant-tracking integrations (for example via SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Posting) are arranged through its sales and support teams under contract. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and enriched from 51job's public web properties.

providers.name: Comento
providers.description: Comento is a South Korean career development and mentoring platform based in Seoul that connects job seekers with working professionals. The service offers a Q&A community and timeline for career discussions, free unlimited mentoring questions answered by industry practitioners, resume and cover letter (자기소개서) review, an AI resume analyzer, interview preparation, and job-focused educational programs including bootcamps (직무부트캠프) and classes for the Korean job market. It also runs corporate training and university affiliation partnerships. Comento operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched with the domain and identity signals that are publicly observable.

providers.name: HealthEquity
providers.description: HealthEquity is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The HealthEquity API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Joblocal
providers.description: Joblocal GmbH is a Munich-based German recruiting technology company and a part of the Funke Mediengruppe. With more than fifteen years of experience it operates a network of 41 regional job portals across Germany and, together with the Funke network, runs data-driven, hyper-regional recruiting campaigns tailored to position, location and budget for over 1,000 client companies. Its "Talent.KI" product applies artificial intelligence to candidate sourcing and regional labor-market analysis, surfacing employers where job seekers actually search. Joblocal was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Nexiu
providers.description: Nexiu (Nexiu AI LLC) is a Latin America-focused recruiting automation platform that uses AI agents to source, contact, screen, and schedule high-volume candidates over the official WhatsApp Business API, integrating with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and existing ATS systems and job boards. It offers a fully managed pay-per-hire service (Nexiu Managed) and a self-service SaaS platform (Nexiu Platform) for internal talent-acquisition teams, and is backed by 500 Global (500 Latam) and NVIDIA Inception. As of this pass Nexiu consumes third-party APIs (WhatsApp Business, Google, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) but does not publish a public developer API of its own.

providers.name: Numbi
providers.description: Numbi is a tech-enabled accounting and payroll firm for Colombian companies — especially SAS entities, SMBs, and startups. It pairs expert accountants with automation and AI to run monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN electronic-invoicing compliance. Numbi is a service rather than software or an ERP: it operates on top of a company's existing accounting systems (Siigo and Alegra) instead of replacing them, ingesting documents (PDFs, XMLs, images) and keeping tax calendars and filings current. Founded in Bogotá and backed by Homebrew and Newtopia VC. No public developer API surface is published as of this pass.

providers.name: Trace
providers.description: Trace (tracehq.com) is a workforce planning, headcount management, and procurement platform where companies plan and manage headcount as their most important investment, offering instant workforce analytics and headcount planning. Trace was backed by 500 Global and Uncork Capital, was acquired by Paylocity (now branded "TraceHQ, A Paylocity Company"), and the standalone Trace app is being sunset in early 2026 as the product folds into Paylocity for Finance headcount planning. Trace publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: TrueBlue
providers.description: TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI) is a leading provider of workforce solutions and specialized talent services. TrueBlue connects people and work through three operating segments: PeopleReady (industrial staffing), PeopleScout (RPO and talent advisory), and Staff Management | SMX (managed staffing). TrueBlue's digital platforms include JobStack for on-demand industrial staffing and Affinix for recruitment process outsourcing.

providers.name: Lyra Health
providers.description: Lyra Health is a Burlingame, California enterprise mental health benefits company founded in 2015 that provides employer-sponsored behavioral health care to more than 20 million members across a network of 30,000+ providers in over 200 countries and territories. The platform combines preventive self-care resources, coaching, evidence-based therapy, medication management, family and pediatric services, and specialized acute care delivered through a benefits-administration model sold to large employers and health plans rather than directly to consumers. Lyra's product surface includes the Lyra App for members, the Lyra Empower AI-powered care platform launched in 2025, Centers of Excellence for pediatric mental health and neurodiversity, a manager coaching program, and a clinical-grade AI guide. Customers include Salesforce, Lululemon, Morgan Stanley, Genentech, Starbucks, JE Dunn, VCA, and the School District of Philadelphia, and in March 2026 the company became Workday Wellness's preferred mental health partner. Lyra acquired pediatric and family mental health provider Bend Health in July 2025. Lyra is led by CEO Jennifer Schulz, with Jenny Gonsalves as Chief Product & Technology Officer, Alethea Varra as Chief Clinical Officer, and co-founder Bob Kocher, MD on the board. The company's revenue model is per-member-per- month employer contracts plus utilization-based clinical billing; Lyra does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or self-service API, and its only public GitHub repository is an internal fork of an unrelated infrastructure module. All employer, member, HRIS/eligibility, SSO, and EHR integrations are negotiated and delivered through the Lyra customer success and implementation teams rather than through a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Zebec Network
providers.description: Zebec Network is a blockchain infrastructure company (founded 2021, San Francisco; founder Sam Thapaliya) building real-time payroll, on-chain payments, multi-chain debit/crypto cards, and treasury management for web3 businesses and individuals. Its continuous-settlement streaming protocol began on Solana and now spans EVM chains, NEAR, and BNB via a Wormhole-based cross-chain bridge. Zebec exposes its capabilities to developers as a family of first-party TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs published on npm under the @zebec-network, @zebec-protocol, and @zebec-fintech scopes — covering payroll streaming, the vault, staking, the Silver/instant cards, the bridge, and the Solana DAO — documented at docs.zebec.io. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Convergys
providers.description: Convergys was a global leader in customer management services, providing customer care, technology services, and analytics across industries before being acquired by Concentrix in October 2018. The legacy convergys.com domain now redirects to Concentrix, and Convergys offerings such as contact center outsourcing, workforce management, analytics, and digital customer experience platforms have been folded into the Concentrix portfolio. Concentrix itself does not publish public REST APIs or developer programs in the way SaaS vendors do. Most platform integrations are delivered through enterprise contracts and private APIs.

providers.name: EMERGENCES AI, INC.
providers.description: EMERGENCES AI, INC. (Emergences Labs) builds human competency models, assessment, and training solutions for the AI era, focused on defining the transformative skills whose value compounds rather than erodes as AI advances. Its products include NeoWork, real-world task assessments for recruiting and identifying top performers in AI-native roles and for reskilling; NeoHuman, deliberate-practice training that teaches professionals and students effective human-AI collaboration through real enterprise work; and an expert-curated Data offering of annotated professional workflow trajectories for agent reinforcement learning and domain-specific benchmarks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a public website with research, blog, careers, and legal pages, but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: FutureFit AI
providers.description: FutureFit AI is an AI-powered workforce technology company that connects people to careers, employers to talent, and workforce partners to tools for integrated and intelligent workforce systems. Its Pathways Platform powers workforce-system transformation while its Career Copilot delivers AI-driven career guidance across career navigation, labor exchange, employment services, virtual career centers, upskilling and reskilling, and industry talent pipelines. The company serves workforce development, economic development, and enterprise customers. As of this enrichment pass FutureFit AI publishes a marketing and product site but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Northstar
providers.description: Northstar is an employer-sponsored financial wellness benefit that helps employees understand, manage, and get the most out of their total compensation and personal finances. Delivered as a workplace benefit (offered by employers to their workforce), Northstar pairs financial guidance with tools for budgeting, saving, equity/compensation planning, and overall money management. The company is a fintech provider backed by GGV Capital. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass, Northstar publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages, but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface — its product is consumed as an employee benefit, not as a developer API.

providers.name: Pack
providers.description: Pack is an AI-powered skill management platform for HR and People teams. The product helps organizations map skills into future-proof ontologies, assess proficiency across teams, identify strategic skill gaps, and build personalized development plans for employees. Additional capabilities include business impact analysis, a Return on Development Investment (RODI) calculator, and access to a network of 1,000+ certified trainers for mentoring and coaching. Pack integrates with existing HRIS and LMS systems. The company (Pack SRL) has raised approximately EUR 5.8M and is backed by Anthemis and Techstars. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Pack publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: PayScale
providers.description: PayScale is a compensation intelligence and salary data company that helps organizations and individuals price jobs, benchmark pay, and manage compensation. Its platform combines a Peer Data Ecosystem of daily-refreshed, HRIS-sourced salary data across thousands of organizations and millions of employee records with survey-based and crowdsourced pay data spanning tens of thousands of jobs across many countries. Products include the Payscale Ascent compensation management platform, market pricing and benchmarking datasets (Peer Global, Peer Enhanced, Peer Industry, Peer Markets), pay equity analytics, and consumer-facing salary research tools. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; PayScale publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time, so this entry captures company identity, links, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Puddle
providers.description: Puddle is a technical-interview platform for evaluating software-engineering candidates in real-world, AI-enabled conditions. Candidates work through live coding assessments inside a sandboxed environment with an integrated IDE and terminal, and are free to use modern AI tools (such as Claude Code) during the session. Puddle captures detailed signals about how a candidate approaches a problem across structured phases (problem discussion, architecture, implementation, and debrief) and produces an outcome report with confidence scores, focus and iteration-pace metrics, and hiring recommendations. It is sold as a B2B SaaS recruitment-assessment tool via demo and early-access waitlist. Puddle was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass Puddle publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; the profile below captures its verifiable public web and security presence.

providers.name: Schedex
providers.description: Schedex is a workforce management platform built for food and beverage businesses, consolidating staff scheduling, shift management, attendance tracking, and payroll into a single mobile-first application. It offers mobile clock in/out with location technology, schedule optimization across multiple locations, real-time labor-cost tracking and reporting, automated wage and payroll calculation, leave requests and shift exchange, and a multilingual branded app, with the goal of reducing labor costs by up to 15 percent. Schedex was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Sona
providers.description: Sona is an AI-powered workforce management platform for large, multi-site organizations in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics. It unifies labor demand forecasting, autonomous staff scheduling, core HR (onboarding, absence, training), and payroll automation, with a Raffy AI assistant that guides manager decisions plus real-time analytics across locations. Sona ships 95+ pre-built integrations (ATS, POS, LMS, tipping, earned-wage-access, and care-planning systems) and advertises a private API for building bespoke integrations, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (Northzone, Polychain, Speedinvest) and enriched via the local pipeline.

providers.name: Sounding Board
providers.description: Sounding Board is a leadership development company offering tech-powered coaching and mentoring solutions that help organizations develop dynamic leaders at every level. Its platform pairs software products (Expand, Guide, and Transform) with a global network of ICF/EMCC/IAC/CCE-certified coaches to deliver 1:1 coaching, group coaching, mentoring, and on-demand leadership development. Sounding Board serves technology, professional services, government, education, healthcare, financial services, and retail organizations, and was acquired by BTS in March 2025 to extend end-to-end executive-to-frontline coaching. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners; no public developer or API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Trayd
providers.description: Trayd is a construction payroll, HR, and compliance platform built for commercial trade contractors and subcontractors. It automates certified and prevailing-wage payroll, union and multi-state compliance reporting, field and labor tracking, crew scheduling and dispatch, HR onboarding and benefits, and offers same-day pay, moving tens of millions of payroll dollars each week. Founded in 2022 (Y Combinator S23) and backed by Bloomberg Beta, Trayd operates a private SaaS and mobile application with no public developer API, documentation, or integration surface published at this time.

providers.name: Zolvers
providers.description: Zolvers is a home-services marketplace that connects households with vetted, background-checked domestic and home-maintenance workers across Latin America, operating in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile with a focus on Buenos Aires, Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, and Monterrey. The platform handles service requests, worker vetting, scheduling, and integrated payment processing for housekeeping and cleaning (one-time and live-in) plus home maintenance such as plumbing, electrical, gas, painting, air conditioning, general repairs, upholstery cleaning, and elder care. Backed by 500 Global, Zolvers is a consumer-facing platform with no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Free Agency
providers.description: Free Agency is a careers company and talent marketplace that pairs technology professionals with an AI-powered Talent Agent which proactively surfaces relevant work — full-time roles and short project engagements with defined deliverables, duration, and compensation. Founded by Sherveen Mashayekhi and backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company has raised a $10M Series A and counts talent placed at companies such as OpenAI, Stripe, and Figma. It also publishes Intent, a newsletter for careerists, and runs CareerMakers, a cohort course hosted on Maven. As of August 2026 the entire public surface is a single waitlist landing page with two Tally intake forms — one for individual talent and one "For AI companies" — plus the Intent newsletter and an Ashby-hosted job board. Free Agency exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as a company stub with a probed, verified absence rather than an unexamined gap.

providers.name: Betterfly
providers.description: Betterfly is a Latin American insurtech and employee-benefits platform that combines voluntary insurance coverage with daily health engagement and rewards. Its integrated benefits product serves three audiences — brokers, employers, and employees — pairing guaranteed-issue life and health insurance with wellness programs, health assessments, and engagement mechanics so that employees actively use their benefits and employers gain visibility into participation and ROI. Founded in Chile, Betterfly operates across the region and is backed by QED Investors. This profile was surfaced from the QED Investors portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Betterfly publishes no public developer or API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Handl Health
providers.description: Handl Health is a healthcare price-transparency AI platform that turns the negotiated rates, gross charges, and cash prices unlocked by the Hospital Price Transparency and Transparency in Coverage rules into clean, usable pricing intelligence. Using proprietary AI models, Handl cleans and organizes publicly available machine-readable pricing files at scale and supplements them with claims, Medicare rates, and provider-directory data to build a holistic, validated dataset. Its products — Iris, AI-driven network analytics for benefits consultants to evaluate and compare carrier networks, and Arke, real-time cost tools that help plan members find high-value care — serve benefits consultants, carriers, third-party administrators, and employers designing alternative health plans. Handl is a Techstars- and StartUp Health-backed company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API or portal was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Calificadas
providers.description: Calificadas is a Mexico-based, AI-powered human development company that combines artificial intelligence, strategic consulting, and training to help organizations and teams adapt to rapid change. Its tagline is "human infrastructure for the era of artificial intelligence." Its flagship product, CUALY (cualy.tech), is an AI-native platform for developing human capabilities through diagnosis, personalization, and continuous AI-driven feedback across communication, leadership, and collaboration, using voice and video analysis and AI coaches, plus organizational dashboards and iOS/Android apps. The company also delivers organizational consulting, leadership training, and adaptive training programs, and counts Coca-Cola FEMSA, ManpowerGroup, and Alsea among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Calificadas was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; artifacts below reflect its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: MindSumo
providers.description: MindSumo was a crowdsourcing and open-innovation platform that connected companies with a community of students and young professionals to solve time-boxed business challenges for monetary prizes, generating ideas, market insight, and hiring leads. A GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company later acquired by MBO Partners, the platform distributed over $1.3M in rewards across 1,300+ challenges in 200+ countries before being permanently shut down after 13 years of operation. MindSumo never published a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile records its identity and the residual public web properties (terms, privacy) that remain live.

providers.name: OVIA
providers.description: OVIA is listed via wepow.com, the domain of Wepow, a video-interviewing and candidate-assessment startup backed by 500 Global. Wepow is now part of Harver, a Talent Intelligence platform offering pre-employment assessments, automated interview scheduling, video interviewing, game-based assessments (pymetrics), and reference checking (Checkster). wepow.com 301-redirects to harver.com, and the served /.well-known documents and llms.txt are Harver's. This entry has no independent, self-service public API surface; enrichment captured the live security, well-known, and AI-governance signals published on the domain.

providers.name: Pariti
providers.description: Pariti is an AI-powered talent acquisition platform that helps companies source, vet, and hire candidates through a community-driven referral network of thousands of leaders, technologists, and recruiters. It pairs recruiter-trained AI/ML candidate screening with salary benchmarking (Salary Insights) and a Talent Engine that aims to move roles from open to offer in about four weeks. Pariti is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, MCP server, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence and security posture as a lead awaiting a real API surface.

providers.name: Alan
providers.description: Alan is a Paris-based digital health insurance and wellness company founded in 2016 by Jean-Charles Samuelian-Werve and Charles Gorintin. It was the first independent health insurance provider licensed in France in over fifty years and offers an integrated product combining complementary health insurance ("mutuelle"), prevention, and care delivery through a single mobile and web experience. Alan's product surface includes group and individual health plans (Alan Santé), retirement plans (Alan Dolce Vita), public-sector and self-employed offerings, an HR/benefits admin dashboard for employers, an in-house telehealth and chat-care service (Clinique Alan) staffed by salaried clinicians, a gamified prevention and step-tracking program (Alan Play / Alan Mind), and vision/optical benefits with zero out-of-pocket pricing. The company reports over one million members and roughly 33,000 client businesses, operates in France, Belgium, and Spain, and reached a reported €5B valuation in its 2026 Series F round. Engineering and product practice is documented publicly on the Alan Product and Technical Blog at medium.com/alan, and a small portfolio of internal-tools and design assets (most notably react-native-fast-shadow and the Alan Sans typeface) is open-sourced on github.com/alan-eu. Alan does not publish a public-facing developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; all member and employer interactions happen through Alan's first-party apps and the HR/benefits dashboard.

providers.name: ANSR
providers.description: ANSR Global is a workforce and operations company that helps enterprises build, manage, and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) — captive technology and shared-services hubs, most often in India and other emerging markets. Its end-to-end offering spans four areas: Talent Solutions (AI-driven recruiting, sourcing, onboarding, and talent management), Workspace (managed, customized office space and workplace strategy), Business Operations (payroll, HR, employer-of-record, compliance, legal, and finance/tax), and Research & Advisory (organizational design, capability planning, and market intelligence). ANSR engages clients through Global Capability Center subscriptions, Build-Operate-Transfer arrangements, and Managed Teams, and operates a proprietary workforce platform, 1Wrk. The company reports 20+ years of operations, 210+ global centers established, 225,000+ professionals hired, and 14M+ square feet of managed workspace. ANSR is a portfolio company of Accel. It is a business-services provider and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP
providers.description: Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP is a global Am Law 10 firm with approximately 2,200 lawyers and 39 offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The firm provides corporate, transactional, litigation, and regulatory services across energy, financial services, healthcare, life sciences, retail and ecommerce, sports, technology, and transportation, with widely recognized depth in employee benefits and executive compensation, fintech and financial services regulation, intellectual property, and M&A. Morgan Lewis does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or machine-readable data product; its public technology surface is limited to its corporate website, an email-alert subscription managed through a Real Magnet (REACTION) marketing platform, and a portfolio of LexBlog-style practice blogs covering specific subject areas.

providers.name: Beisen
providers.description: Beisen (北森) is a China-based enterprise software company and the country's largest cloud-native Human Capital Management (HCM) and talent-management SaaS provider, delivered through its iTalent platform. Its integrated suite spans recruiting and applicant tracking, talent assessment and psychometric testing, performance and goals (OKR), core HR and personnel records, compensation, learning and development, and succession planning for large enterprises. Beisen operates an Open Platform (open.italent.cn) that lets partners and customers integrate HR data and workflows into the iTalent ecosystem via web APIs. The company is publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9669) and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company.

providers.name: Swile
providers.description: Swile is a French fintech that operates an all-in-one employee-benefits and engagement super-app built around a single Mastercard smartcard and mobile app. Founded in 2018 as Lunchr and rebranded Swile in 2020, it consolidates meal vouchers (titres-restaurant), gift and culture vouchers, mobility and work-from-home allowances, and team/recognition budgets that were historically spread across paper vouchers and multiple providers. The company merged with Bimpli in France, expanded into Brazil through Vee Benefícios, and is backed by investors including Index Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Bpifrance. Swile serves employers and their employees rather than external developers: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a security surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, and a researcher hall of fame) but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or API reference.

providers.name: Glint
providers.description: Glint is an employee-engagement and organizational-health platform built on people-science pulse surveys, manager dashboards, and action-planning analytics. Founded in 2013 and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Shasta Ventures, Glint was acquired by LinkedIn in 2018 and subsequently folded into Microsoft, where it now ships as Microsoft Viva Glint within the Microsoft Viva employee-experience suite. The original glintinc.com domain now redirects to Microsoft, and the product is administered through the Microsoft 365 tenant and Microsoft Entra ID rather than a standalone public developer API; Glint does not publish an independent OpenAPI, REST API reference, or developer portal.

providers.name: Meta4
providers.description: Meta4 is a human capital management (HCM) software provider founded in Madrid, Spain, delivering cloud-based payroll, talent, and time-management applications widely used across the Spanish-speaking world and Europe. Backed by Insight Partners, Meta4 was acquired by Cegid in 2019 and its PeopleNet HCM platform is now delivered as part of the Cegid HR product family. The developer surface — Core HR, payroll, and talent APIs — is published through the Cegid HR developer portal rather than a standalone Meta4 developer program.

providers.name: ConverzAI
providers.description: ConverzAI is a Seattle-based artificial intelligence company (founded 2019) that builds an agentic, voice-first AI platform for the recruitment and staffing industry. Its flagship Virtual Recruiter deploys autonomous AI agents that source, engage, screen, and match candidates through natural conversations over voice, text, and email, then update the customer's applicant tracking system automatically. The platform integrates with major ATS products used by staffing firms (Avionte, Bullhorn, Ceipal, JobDiva, Salesforce, TempWorks and others) and lets a single recruiter engage hundreds of thousands of candidates in parallel. ConverzAI raised a $16M Series A led by Menlo Ventures in February 2025 and reports processing over 100,000 jobs while engaging millions of candidates. This is a product/application company profile; ConverzAI does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Knowify
providers.description: Knowify is a New York-based construction management SaaS for trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, painting, remodeling, concrete, excavation), covering the full job lifecycle from bidding through payment on a single platform. The product spans project execution (estimating, proposals and contracts, change orders, RFIs and submittals, scheduling, daily logs, document and photo management), service work (dispatch, invoicing, payments, field operations, asset and inventory management), and financial management (AIA billing, job costing, prevailing wage, purchase orders, expenses, WIP and reporting). Knowify is positioned as the official construction software partner of QuickBooks Online and offers deep two-way sync with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Payroll, QuickBooks Payments, and QuickBooks Time, alongside native integrations with CompanyCam, Billd, Lumber, eBacon, and AIA Contract Documents. Third-party automation is available via Zapier. Pricing starts at $99/month (Core), $249/month (Advanced), and custom Enterprise, with paid add-ons for Service Pro, Live Equipment Tracking (FleetSharp), AI Dashcams, and Tool Tracking. Knowify does not publish a public REST API, webhooks specification, SDK, CLI, or developer portal; programmatic access for third parties is limited to Zapier and the QuickBooks ecosystem.

providers.name: MicroBenefits
providers.description: MicroBenefits is a workforce-engagement and HR technology company, backed by 500 Global, that created CompanyIQ — a scalable mobile platform for improving engagement, learning, and communication for factory and manufacturing workers, particularly across Asia. CompanyIQ bundles Worker Voice (employee feedback and dialogue), Digital Learning (safety, rights, and professional-development training), an Employee Portal (wage, hours, and benefits transparency), and Business Intelligence workforce analytics, alongside professional and learning services. The company operates a marketing and support presence but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time.

providers.name: Peoplise
providers.description: Peoplise (now Logo Peoplise) is a Turkish human-resources technology SaaS that digitalizes recruitment and hiring workflows for enterprises. The platform covers the full talent-acquisition funnel: candidate sourcing and application tracking, automated pre-screening and assessments, one-way and live video interviews, reference checking, and digital onboarding. Originally a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company, Peoplise was acquired by Logo (Logo Yazilim), one of Turkey's largest enterprise-software vendors, and is marketed as "Logo Peoplise" at logo.com.tr. Public probing found a marketing/product site only; no developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, /.well-known/ discovery surface, or documented public API was found at this time.

providers.name: SALARY HERO PTE. LTD
providers.description: Salary Hero is a Singapore-headquartered financial wellness and earned wage access (EWA) platform offered to employees through their employers. Its products include Salary on Demand (accessing earned wages before payday), budgeting and spending-tracking tools, savings accounts (a partnership with Dime offering 3% interest), and financial-literacy education covering debt management and investing. The service is delivered via iOS and Android apps and is provisioned by employers, integrating with existing payroll and HR systems. Salary Hero is a portfolio company of 500 Global. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Karpatia Benefits
providers.description: Karpatia Benefits is an all-in-one corporate employee-benefits management platform used by 100+ companies to administer insurance, sports and education allowances, and mental-health support for distributed teams. It combines a benefits marketplace of 40+ partner vendors offering corporate discounts, reimbursement processing, and HR analytics dashboards, and says it removes roughly 95% of the administrative work of running a benefits program. The company primarily serves Ukrainian companies with multi-country localization. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Hireguide
providers.description: Hireguide is a structured-interviewing and hiring-intelligence platform, originally a Techstars-backed startup, that helped talent teams run consistent, evidence-based interviews with guided question banks, scorecards, interview recording and AI-assisted candidate evaluation grounded in industrial-organizational hiring science. Hireguide's team and technology were acquired by HireVue in 2026; the primary domain now redirects to HireVue's AI Interviewer platform, while trust.hireguide.com remains live and Hireguide-branded, publishing the company's compliance posture (SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; no independent public developer/API surface was found for Hireguide.

providers.name: YOURIKA
providers.description: YOURIKA (YOURIKA Labs) is a Kitchener-Waterloo, Canada AI platform and venture studio that creates and scales purpose-built, verticalized AI ventures in partnership with industry experts, prioritizing accuracy, trust, and measurable outcomes over technology-first approaches. Its ventures include smart'n, a nurse-first intelligence and learning platform that helps nurses learn, grow, and make more informed decisions throughout their careers, and Retain / Workforce Intelligence for senior and long-term care, which helps operators identify, hire, and retain caregivers while reducing turnover. yourikaLABS also offers AI advisory services connecting businesses with experts to build data-driven strategies and roadmaps. YOURIKA is backed by Amazon, Techstars (Amazon Alexa Accelerator), and the University of Waterloo. The company exposes no bespoke public developer API; its marketing site is built on Wix and advertises a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for agentic access.

providers.name: Homethrive
providers.description: Homethrive is a technology-enabled caregiving-support benefit sold to employers, health plans, financial institutions, ancillary insurers, brokers, and platform partners. It pairs a digital assistant (Homethrive Dari) with human Care Guides to help family caregivers navigate backup care, aging, complex health, estate planning, and loss for their loved ones. Homethrive is a B2B2C member platform - it is delivered to covered members through their employer or health plan, not as a self-serve product. There is no public or partner developer API, API reference, or developer portal. Customer integration is handled during enterprise onboarding via an eligibility-file specification (typically SFTP/CSV batch files) and Single Sign-On (SSO), with utilization and engagement data returned to the sponsor - all arranged through implementation, not a documented self-service API.

providers.name: Truveris
providers.description: Truveris is an independent pharmacy benefits consulting and analytics firm, founded in 2009 and headquartered in New York, that helps employers, benefits consultants, and brokers optimize their pharmacy programs and reduce drug spend. The company turns complex pharmacy claims and contract data into clear, actionable insight through products including the Truveris Marketplace for PBM plan procurement, truGuard for ongoing contract and pricing oversight, pharmacy audits, and PBM contract analytics. Truveris serves hundreds of clients with data-driven cost containment strategies. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties. Backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Aon
providers.description: Aon plc is a London-headquartered global professional services firm delivering integrated risk and human capital advisory through two reporting pillars — Risk Capital (broking, reinsurance, risk analytics) and Human Capital (health, wealth, talent, rewards). The firm operates in over 120 countries, lists on the NYSE under the ticker AON, and grew its US middle-market footprint with the April 2024 acquisition of NFP for roughly $13B. Aon publishes named analytics platforms (Risk Analyzer suite, ReMetrica, CyQu, Spectrum, Impact Forecasting catastrophe models, Radford McLagan Compensation Database, SkillsGraph, Gauge, Revenue GPS) but those tools are delivered through gated client portals — no developer portal, OpenAPI catalog, SDK org, or public API reference is published on aon.com.

providers.name: Altru
providers.description: Altru (Altru Labs, Inc.) was a mobile-first, employee-generated video storytelling platform for recruitment marketing and talent acquisition, enabling organizations to capture, edit, brand, approve, and distribute authentic employee video content across career sites, social media, and email/text campaigns, with video transcription in 14+ languages. Founded in 2017 and based in Brooklyn, New York, and backed by Techstars, Altru served brands including Target, PwC, Intuit, L'Oreal, and Box before being acquired by iCIMS on December 14, 2020 and folded into the iCIMS Talent Cloud. Altru no longer operates as an independent provider — altrulabs.com now redirects to icims.com and there is no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: bannerman
providers.description: Bannerman is a San Francisco-based technology company that operates a security guard marketplace, connecting businesses with screened, licensed, insured, and certified security professionals. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator S14) and backed by Slow Ventures, FundersClub, and Y Combinator, Bannerman brings software and technology to the traditionally manual physical-security-services industry. Its web dashboard lets clients book, schedule, and manage on-site security officers, run real-time GPS patrol tracking and incident reporting, handle communications, and manage billing from a single security-officer-management platform. Clients have included Lyft, WeWork, BMW, Juul, and YSL, with service across San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, and Chicago. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts are published at this time.

providers.name: Mogul
providers.description: Mogul is a modern executive advisory, training, and executive search firm serving 600+ leading companies, with particular focus on leadership development and AI transformation across retail, consumer goods, healthcare, media, and nonprofit sectors. Its services span executive advisory (fractional AI and HR leadership, AI adoption and change management, AI agent buildout), executive training (signature programs from "AI Readiness for Enterprise" through "Organizational Leadership," delivered on-demand or live), and executive search (C-suite, board, and professional placements with succession planning). Mogul reports having educated 1MM+ leaders and counts Amazon, Google, Disney, Microsoft, and Nike among its clients. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Mogul publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation; it operates as a B2B services and training business.

providers.name: Powerus
providers.description: PowerUs is Germany's largest job platform for skilled trades and crafts, connecting tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, roofers, metalworkers, mechanics and more) with employers across construction, electrical and mechanical industries. The platform offers automated job matching based on location, salary and working conditions, one-click applications without cover letters, direct employer-to-worker discovery, and native iOS and Android apps. PowerUs reports 250,000+ registered skilled workers and 6,000+ open positions. It is a consumer/employer marketplace product and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI-described API surface; its api.powerus.de and docs.powerus.de hosts are private/internal (docs gated behind Cloudflare Access). Backed by General Catalyst and HV Capital.

providers.name: Resti Inc.
providers.description: Resti Inc. (resti.cloud) is a cloud-based restaurant management platform used by restaurant chains, primarily across Kazakhstan and Central Asia. It automates HR and payroll (salary calculation from actual hours worked), operational checklists and standards with photo verification, review and reputation management aggregating 2GIS and Yandex Maps, a mobile learning management system (LMS) for staff onboarding and training, and AI-assisted invoice processing and reconciliation. Resti integrates with restaurant POS and back-office systems including iiko, r_keeper, Paloma 365, Poster, and 1C Retail, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation; the customer login portal is at my.resti.cloud.

providers.name: JOBDOH
providers.description: JOBDOH is a Hong Kong-based on-demand hiring and staffing platform that connects employers with temporary, part-time, and short-term workers, letting businesses staff up within 24 hours and job seekers find flexible work in one minute. The bilingual (English/Chinese) service spans market research, sales and promotion, exhibitions and events, hospitality, personal assistance, logistics, creative, and beauty roles. Hiring and job applications run through a mobile-app and web experience; there is no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fond
providers.description: Fond (formerly AnyPerk) is a U.S. employee rewards and recognition platform that lets companies run customizable recognition programs combining monetary and non-monetary rewards, perks, and a global rewards catalog. Fond offers a gated public/provider API that allows authenticated partners to programmatically manage a Fond account — provisioning, employee roster management, giving recognition to one or more employees, and rewards redemption — alongside integrations for Workday, ADP, Namely, Salesforce, Slack, and other HR systems. There is no open developer portal or published OpenAPI; API access is arranged directly via integration@fond.co. Fond was acquired by Reward Gateway in March 2023 and fond.co now redirects to rewardgateway.com. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Textio
providers.description: Textio is an augmented-writing platform that uses AI to help managers and HR teams write clearer, more actionable, and less biased performance feedback, recruiting outreach, and job posts. Used by 100,000+ managers at companies including T-Mobile, NASDAQ, Strava, and Upwork, Textio analyzes tone and language as people write and flags biased, low-impact, or unclear phrasing in real time. It is delivered as a web application with browser and editor integrations. Probing textio.com found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, developer portal, or .well-known discovery documents (the site is a HubSpot-hosted single-page app that serves a soft-404 shell for all such paths); api.textio.com exposes only an application health check. Textio does operate a public system status page.

providers.name: Tryprism
providers.description: Prism (tryprism.com) is a San Francisco, Y Combinator-backed AI-powered recruiting agency that delivers qualified talent leads to hiring teams faster and more affordably than traditional recruiters. Clients describe the role they need to fill, Prism's AI handles sourcing, screening, and candidate outreach end-to-end, and clients interview only pre-screened candidates. Pricing is 15% of first-year salary per hire (versus the typical 20-30% agency fee) plus a retainer to initiate and prioritize the search, charged only when a hire is made. As of this profile Prism operates as a managed recruiting service and publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or discovery surface.

providers.name: 58.com
providers.description: 58.com (58同城, "58 Tongcheng") is China's largest online classifieds and local-services marketplace, often called the "Chinese Craigslist." Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing, it operates listings across recruitment and jobs, real estate and housing (Anjuke), used goods (Zhuanzhuan), automobiles, local services, and yellow-pages business directories. Formerly listed on the NYSE (WUBA), it was taken private in 2020 by a Warburg Pincus / General Atlantic consortium. Its 58 Open Platform (open.58.com) exposes payment, recruitment/jobs data, housing, local-service information, security risk-control, marketing, and social capabilities to approved third-party partners via reviewed developer accounts and API keys. Backed historically by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Smashfly
providers.description: SmashFly Technologies was a recruitment-marketing software company whose Total Recruitment Marketing Platform combined a career-site CMS, a candidate CRM, programmatic job advertising, and recruiting analytics for enterprise talent-acquisition teams. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, SmashFly was acquired by Symphony Talent in 2019 and its product folded into the Symphony Talent (SFX / SmashFlyX) suite. SmashFly historically exposed RESTful integration APIs — a Job Import API, a Contact Import API, a Contact Export API, and a List Lookup API — secured with per-organization API keys generated by an administrator in the SmashFly Console. The standalone developer documentation at recruit.smashfly.com has since been retired (the host now returns an empty 302), smashfly.com redirects to symphonytalent.com, and the remaining SmashFly developer resources are hosted in the Symphony Talent support center.

providers.name: Ravio
providers.description: Ravio is a real-time compensation benchmarking and total-rewards platform for people and reward teams. Companies connect their HRIS to contribute anonymized headcount and pay data and, in return, access live salary, equity and benefits benchmarks segmented by role, level, location and sector, replacing static annual salary surveys. Backed by Northzone. No public developer API, docs portal or SDK surface was discovered during enrichment; security posture (Vanta trust center, domain security) was probed.

providers.name: Lendtable
providers.description: Lendtable was a US consumer fintech that extended a line of credit so individuals could afford to max out employer-sponsored benefits they would otherwise leave on the table — primarily the employer 401(k) match and Employee Stock Purchase Plans (ESPP). In its own words: "Lendtable gives a line of credit to help individuals get their employer 401(k) match and ESPP." The product advanced cash against a user's paycheck contributions and took a share of the resulting gains, and was distributed direct-to-consumer and through employers via a Lendtable for Business offering, alongside an iOS app and a Zendesk help center. Lendtable was backed by Partech among others. The company now appears defunct: lendtable.com, the blog, and all product paths return HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED (probed 2026-07-19), the iOS App Store listing is delisted, and the last successful Internet Archive capture of the live site is 2024-12-06. DNS, Google Workspace mail (MX/SPF/DMARC) and the GitHub organization remain registered. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts were ever published by this company.

providers.name: UrbanHire
providers.description: UrbanHire was an Indonesian all-in-one hiring and assessment platform (applicant tracking system) backed by 500 Global, designed to streamline recruitment and help employers hire the right talent. The company appears defunct - urbanhire.com has been offline behind Cloudflare (HTTP 530) with the last archived homepage from January 2021 - and it never published a public API or developer documentation. Its GitHub organization and first-party npm engineering packages remain the surviving technical footprint.

providers.name: Utopia Labs
providers.description: Utopia Labs was a stablecoin payments and finance-operations platform for crypto-native teams and DAOs, covering payments, payroll, invoicing, and approval workflows, backed by Paradigm. Coinbase acquired Utopia Labs Corp. on November 13, 2024, and the team joined Base to build onchain payments into Coinbase Wallet. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no public API surface — utopialabs.com returns 404 and its former docs, api, and app subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Arbeitnow
providers.description: API for Job board aggregator in Europe / Remote

providers.name: Bright Horizons Family Solutions
providers.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. (NYSE: BFAM) is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care in the United States, headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and founded in 1986 by Linda Mason and Roger Brown. The company operates more than 1,000 early-education and child-care centers across the US, UK, Netherlands, and India, serving roughly 1,450 employer clients through three core lines: Full Service Center-Based Child Care (on-site and near-site centers for employer-sponsored families), Back-Up Care (last-minute child, adult/elder, and pet care via in-home and in-center networks), and Educational Advisory Services. The Educational Advisory segment is anchored by EdAssist by Bright Horizons (tuition assistance, student loan repayment, and workforce education administration covering 257 employer clients, 4.7 million eligible learners, and more than $1 billion in education and loan payments administered annually), College Coach (college admissions coaching delivered as an employee benefit), and Sittercity (consumer caregiver marketplace acquired in 2020 and offered through corporate benefits). Bright Horizons sells exclusively to enterprise HR and benefits buyers — 72 of the Fortune 1000's top 100 companies use EdAssist — and does not publish public APIs, SDKs, a developer portal, status page, or a public GitHub organization. The brighthorizons GitHub org exists but contains zero public repositories. This profile documents the corporate structure, segment portfolio, and employer-benefit positioning of a child-care and family-benefits operator that runs a closed B2B technology stack with no third-party developer surface.

providers.name: Healthcaresource.com
providers.description: HealthcareSource is a healthcare-focused talent management software provider whose recruiting, applicant tracking, onboarding, behavioral assessments, learning, and employee performance-management products are used across U.S. healthcare organizations. HealthcareSource was acquired by symplr in July 2021 (from Francisco Partners) and its products are now delivered as part of symplr's healthcare talent-management suite, including symplr Recruiting. No public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found for the brand at profiling time; the healthcaresource.com domain 301-redirects to symplr.com/healthcaresource.

providers.name: Korn Ferry
providers.description: Korn Ferry is a global organizational consulting firm that helps companies design optimal organization structures, recruit and develop talent, and drive performance. The firm offers services across executive search, leadership development, organizational strategy, total rewards, and talent acquisition. Korn Ferry serves clients across industries with a combination of consulting, data, and digital products.

providers.name: Tokaido Health
providers.description: Tokaido Health is an AI-native medication steerage platform anchored in behavioral economics that helps employers and health plans cut pharmacy costs. It identifies same-or-better medications that cost less - via site-of-care steerage, biosimilar substitution, formulary optimization, and polypharmacy reconciliation - and pairs recommendations with incentives that get members to switch, layering on top of the existing PBM and benefits stack. Founded in 2025 in San Mateo, CA; raised $25M in May 2026 led by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API surface is published.

providers.name: AI Dev Jobs
providers.description: AI/ML engineering job aggregator with REST, RSS, and MCP endpoints

providers.name: Day & Zimmermann
providers.description: Day & Zimmermann is a privately held, family-owned diversified industrial services company founded in 1901 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company operates across four primary business segments — Maintenance & Construction (power, nuclear, fossil, renewable, and chemical plants), Munitions (ammunition manufacturing, storage, and demilitarization for the U.S. military, including operation of the Lake City Army Ammunition Plant), Government Services (security, EOD, facility management, and architecture/engineering for federal agencies), and Workforce Solutions (staffing and talent placement via Yoh). The Yoh family has controlled the company since 1961; Harold L. Yoh III serves as Chairman and CEO. Day & Zimmermann reported approximately $2.7 billion in revenue in 2023 with roughly 43,000–52,000 employees across approximately 150 global locations. Day & Zimmermann does not publish any public developer APIs; its business is delivered through long-cycle service contracts, government-owned contractor-operated (GOCO) facilities, and direct client engagements.

providers.name: Leade.rs
providers.description: Leade.rs, Inc. was a two-sided marketplace that matched keynote, motivational, and business speakers with the conferences, corporate events, brands, and press that wanted to book them. Event organizers could search a curated roster and create an event, while speakers maintained a profile covering their availability and topics — the platform's stated aim was to remove the cold-outreach grind from conference programming and surface newer and more diverse voices. The company was co-founded by Loïc Le Meur, the French entrepreneur behind the LeWeb conference and a Silicon Valley angel investor; at acquisition its network was reported at roughly 300 speakers across 11 core fields including crypto, AI, and entrepreneurship. ASX-listed Animoca Brands acquired 100% of the equity on 6 May 2019 for US$0.5 million upfront, intending to grow the roster into a mentor and investor network bridging East and West alongside its Zeroth accelerator, with Le Meur joining Animoca as a venture partner. The product did not survive the acquisition. Leade.rs never published a public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable documentation, and as of the July 2026 enrichment pass the leade.rs domain no longer resolves — it remains registered through December 2026 and is delegated to EuroDNS nameservers, but the zone is not served, so there is no live surface of any kind to harvest. This profile is retained as a historical company record.

providers.name: LegalPad
providers.description: Legalpad (Legalpad Inc, Seattle) was a startup-focused US work-visa and immigration company founded by Todd Heine and Sara Itucas, who first began processing visas together at Teleborder (Y Combinator 2013) and reunited in Techstars Seattle in 2017. Legalpad paired software with staff immigration attorneys to file O-1, H-1B, L-1, TN, E-1/E-2, E-3 and B-1 work visas plus EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-1C, EB-2 and EB-2 NIW employment-based green cards, and said it had helped 500+ companies at roughly one-third the typical processing time. It raised a $2M seed in 2018 and a $10M Series A in 2020 before being acquired by Deel in 2022, after which it operated as "Legalpad by Deel" inside Deel Immigration. The legalpad.io web presence was retired after 2024 and the business now lives on as Deel Immigration. Legalpad never published a public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK or other developer surface, so there is no API artifact to enrich.

providers.name: LookSharp
providers.description: LookSharp (formerly InternMatch) was the largest internship and entry-level jobs marketplace dedicated entirely to US college students and new grads, connecting a marketplace of job-seeking students with employers who used its enterprise recruiting products to build employment brand and streamline campus hiring. Founded in 2009 by Andrew Maguire and Nathan Parcells and backed by 500 Global, LookSharp was acquired by WayUp in 2017; its internmatch.com domain now redirects to wayup.com and the brand no longer operates independently. This profile documents a defunct/acquired company with no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Nowpay
providers.description: NowPay is an employer-integrated financial wellness platform whose core product lets employees access their earned salary early and repay it in installments, positioned as a workplace benefit rather than a consumer lender. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass NowPay publishes only a client-rendered marketing site (nowpay.cash, which redirects to nowpay.com) with no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; every probed path returns the single-page-app shell. This profile therefore carries identity and a live domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Reed
providers.description: Job board aggregator

providers.name: Stoke Talent
providers.description: Stoke Talent is a Freelance Management System (FMS) that lets enterprises source, onboard, manage, and pay external freelancers and contractors in one place while handling worker classification, contracts, tax, legal, and compliance. Founded in Israel and backed by Battery Ventures, Stoke was acquired by Fiverr in November 2021 for roughly $95M and subsequently rebranded as Fiverr Enterprise, now offered under the Fiverr Pro / Fiverr Enterprise product line. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, API reference, SDKs, or webhook documentation; this profile is maintained for network completeness.

providers.name: Talently
providers.description: Talently is a Latin American tech hiring and talent marketplace connecting software engineers and digital professionals (Tech, Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Experience) with technology companies across LATAM and the United States. The platform offers pre-evaluated talent, free job postings, and a suite of hiring tools including per-country tech salary calculators, a technical glossary, and specialized job boards. Backed by 500 Global. Public web surface spans talently.tech plus hire, match, admin, strapi, and stream subdomains; it publishes an llms.txt catalog for AI agents but exposes no public developer/API documentation at this time.

providers.description: US government job board

providers.name: WorkAmerica
providers.description: WorkAmerica was a skilled-labor hiring marketplace that connected job seekers, employers, and educators to close the skills gap - "connecting education to employment, exclusively for the skilled labor force" (archived homepage, 2017). A 500 Global portfolio company, it appears defunct - the workamerica.co domain expired (registrar suspension page captured December 2018) and now 301-redirects to an unrelated Indonesian website. No public API, developer portal, GitHub organization, or packages were found.

providers.name: Workpop
providers.description: Workpop was a Santa Monica, California hiring platform focused on hourly workers, matching employers with job candidates. Backed by Obvious Ventures, Slow Ventures, and Trinity Ventures, it was acquired by Cornerstone OnDemand in 2018 and the product was shut down. Workpop never published a public API; its engineering team left behind twelve first-party npm packages under the @workpop scope. The workpop.com domain has since lapsed and now redirects to an unrelated third-party site.
